161	/-! ## Semilinear Galois actions on schemes over `Spec L` -/
162	
163	variable (K L : Type u) [Field K] [Field L] [Algebra K L]
164	
165	/-- A **semilinear `Gal(L/K)`-action** on a scheme `X` over `Spec L` (campaign
166	`G2(a)`): a group homomorphism into scheme automorphisms of the total space, each
167	automorphism lying in a commuting square over the corresponding Galois automorphism
168	`Spec γ` of the base.  (`X` is *not* acted on over `Spec L` — only the composite
169	descends to `Spec K`; this is exactly Kleiman/Milne's "descent datum" for the finite
170	Galois cover `Spec L → Spec K`.) -/
171	structure SemilinearGalAction (X : Scheme.{u}) (f : X ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of L)) where
172	  /-- The action by scheme automorphisms. -/
173	  act : (L ≃ₐ[K] L) →* Aut X
174	  /-- Each automorphism covers the Galois action `Spec γ` on the base. -/
175	  compat (γ : L ≃ₐ[K] L) :
176	    (act γ).hom ≫ f = f ≫ (toSpecAut (L ≃ₐ[K] L) L γ).hom
177	
178	namespace SemilinearGalAction
179	
180	variable {K L}
181	variable {X : Scheme.{u}} {f : X ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of L)}
182	
183	/-- Equivariance of a morphism between two semilinearly-acted schemes over `Spec L`. -/
184	def IsEquivariant {X' : Scheme.{u}} {f' : X' ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of L)}
185	    (ρ : SemilinearGalAction K L X f) (ρ' : SemilinearGalAction K L X' f')
186	    (h : X ⟶ X') : Prop :=
187	  ∀ γ : L ≃ₐ[K] L, (ρ.act γ).hom ≫ h = h ≫ (ρ'.act γ).hom
188	
189	/-- The `Γ`-orbit of a point of `X` under a semilinear action. -/
190	def orbit (ρ : SemilinearGalAction K L X f) (x : X) : Set X :=
191	  Set.range fun γ : L ≃ₐ[K] L => (ρ.act γ).hom.base x
192	
193	/-- **Orbit-in-affine hypothesis** (campaign `G2`, audit item 8): every `Γ`-orbit is
194	contained in an affine open.  This hypothesis is **essential** (Hironaka trap — see
195	the module docstring): without it the quotient exists only as an algebraic space.
196	For finite Galois `L/K` every orbit is finite, so this is the standard EGA II 4.5.4
197	hypothesis; it holds e.g. for quasi-projective `X` (finite point sets of
198	quasi-projective schemes lie in affine opens) and is supplied to the campaign
199	consumer by the Γ-stable `V_Σ` covers of `J5`. -/
200	class OrbitsInAffineOpen (ρ : SemilinearGalAction K L X f) : Prop where
201	  exists_affineOpen (x : X) :
202	    ∃ U : X.affineOpens, ∀ γ : L ≃ₐ[K] L, (ρ.act γ).hom.base x ∈ U.1
203	
204	/-- A `Γ`-stable open of `X`. -/
205	def IsStableOpen (ρ : SemilinearGalAction K L X f) (U : X.Opens) : Prop :=
206	  ∀ γ : L ≃ₐ[K] L, (ρ.act γ).hom ⁻¹ᵁ U = U
207	
208	end SemilinearGalAction
209	
210	/-- Campaign `G2(a)`, EGA II 4.5.4 pattern: a `Γ`-stable affine refinement — every
211	point admits a `Γ`-stable affine open neighbourhood.
212	
213	**This was a gate and is not one any more; the words "no instances" stood here after
214	its own discharge landed** (`review-ajc`, 2026-07-29 — and they survived one file away
215	from the module-header correction of the same error, which is why they are struck in
216	the class docstring too). `hasStableAffineCover_of_orbitsInAffineOpen`
217	(`Picard/StableAffineCover.lean:279`) is a global `instance` deriving this class from
218	`[FiniteDimensional K L] [IsGalois K L] [ρ.OrbitsInAffineOpen]` — the sanctioned
219	discharge, and the only one. Measured: `infer_instance` succeeds for an *abstract* `ρ`
220	carrying the orbit hypothesis and fails without it, so the orbit hypothesis is exactly
221	its price. `HasGaloisQuotient` below is the gate that remains (it fails to synthesize
222	even with the orbit hypothesis *and* this class in scope).
223	
224	The historical discharge recipe, kept because it records what the proof cost:
225	from `OrbitsInAffineOpen`, given an orbit inside affine `U`, prime avoidance produces
226	`s ∈ Γ(U, 𝒪)` with the orbit inside `D(s) ⊆ ⋂_γ γU`, and the product `∏_γ γ(s)` cuts
227	out a `Γ`-stable affine basic open — a genuine multi-session lemma (walls: transport
228	of sections along the action isomorphisms, and basic-open-affineness bookkeeping),
229	pinned here per the campaign plan ("may be pinned as a separate gated statement if it
230	walls"). -/
231	class HasStableAffineCover {X : Scheme.{u}} {f : X ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of L)}
232	    (ρ : SemilinearGalAction K L X f) : Prop where
233	  exists_stable_affineOpen (x : X) :
234	    ∃ U : X.Opens, IsAffineOpen U ∧ x ∈ U ∧ ρ.IsStableOpen U
235	
236	/-! ## The affine model (conventions validator) -/
237	
238	section AffineModel
239	
240	variable (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [Algebra K A] [Algebra L A] [IsScalarTower K L A]
241	variable [MulSemiringAction (L ≃ₐ[K] L) A]
242	
243	/-- The affine model of a semilinear Galois action: a `MulSemiringAction Γ A` that is
244	`IsSemilinear K L A` induces a semilinear action on `Spec A` over `Spec L`.  This
245	validates the sign/direction conventions of `SemilinearGalAction` constructively. -/
246	noncomputable def specSemilinearGalAction [IsSemilinear K L A] :
247	    SemilinearGalAction K L (Spec (CommRingCat.of A))
248	      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap L A))) where
249	  act := toSpecAut (L ≃ₐ[K] L) A
250	  compat γ := by
251	    rw [toSpecAut_hom, toSpecAut_hom, ← Spec.map_comp, ← Spec.map_comp,
252	      ← CommRingCat.ofHom_comp, ← CommRingCat.ofHom_comp]
253	    congr 2
254	    ext x
255	    exact SemilinearAction.smul_algebraMap K L A γ⁻¹ x
256	
257	end AffineModel
258	
259	/-! ## The canonical action on a base change `T ×_{Spec K} Spec L` -/
260	
261	section PullbackAction
262	
263	/-- Each Galois automorphism of `Spec L` is a morphism over `Spec K`. -/
264	lemma toSpecAut_hom_comp_baseMap (γ : L ≃ₐ[K] L) :
265	    (toSpecAut (L ≃ₐ[K] L) L γ).hom ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K L))
266	      = Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K L)) := by
267	  rw [toSpecAut_hom, ← Spec.map_comp, ← CommRingCat.ofHom_comp]
268	  congr 2
269	  ext x
270	  exact AlgEquiv.commutes γ⁻¹ x
271	
272	variable {Y : Scheme.{u}} (g : Y ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of K))
273	
274	/-- The single automorphism of the base change `Y ×_{Spec K} Spec L` induced by
275	`γ` through the second factor. -/
276	noncomputable abbrev pullbackGalMap (γ : L ≃ₐ[K] L) :
277	    pullback g (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K L)))
278	      ⟶ pullback g (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K L))) :=
279	  pullback.map g _ g _ (𝟙 Y) (toSpecAut (L ≃ₐ[K] L) L γ).hom (𝟙 _)
280	    (by simp) (by rw [Category.comp_id, toSpecAut_hom_comp_baseMap])
281	
282	@[reassoc (attr := simp)]
283	lemma pullbackGalMap_fst (γ : L ≃ₐ[K] L) :
284	    pullbackGalMap K L g γ ≫ pullback.fst g (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K L)))
285	      = pullback.fst g (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K L))) := by
286	  have h : pullbackGalMap K L g γ ≫ pullback.fst g (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K L)))
287	      = pullback.fst g (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K L))) ≫ 𝟙 Y :=
288	    pullback.lift_fst _ _ _
289	  rw [h, Category.comp_id]
290	
291	@[reassoc (attr := simp)]
292	lemma pullbackGalMap_snd (γ : L ≃ₐ[K] L) :
293	    pullbackGalMap K L g γ ≫ pullback.snd g (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K L)))
294	      = pullback.snd g (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K L))) ≫
295	          (toSpecAut (L ≃ₐ[K] L) L γ).hom :=
296	  pullback.lift_snd _ _ _
297	
298	/-- The canonical semilinear Galois action on a base change
299	`Y ×_{Spec K} Spec L → Spec L` through the second factor.  This is the reference
300	action used to *state* equivariance of descent isomorphisms and the `T`-points
301	property. -/
302	noncomputable def pullbackSemilinearGalAction :
303	    SemilinearGalAction K L
304	      (pullback g (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K L))))
305	      (pullback.snd g (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K L)))) where
306	  act := MonoidHom.mk'
307	    (fun γ =>
308	      { hom := pullbackGalMap K L g γ
309	        inv := pullbackGalMap K L g γ⁻¹
310	        hom_inv_id := by
311	          apply pullback.hom_ext
312	          · rw [Category.assoc, pullbackGalMap_fst, pullbackGalMap_fst, Category.id_comp]
313	          · rw [Category.assoc, pullbackGalMap_snd, pullbackGalMap_snd_assoc,
314	              toSpecAut_hom_inv_hom, Category.comp_id, Category.id_comp]
315	        inv_hom_id := by
316	          apply pullback.hom_ext
317	          · rw [Category.assoc, pullbackGalMap_fst, pullbackGalMap_fst, Category.id_comp]
318	          · rw [Category.assoc, pullbackGalMap_snd, pullbackGalMap_snd_assoc,
319	              toSpecAut_inv_hom_hom, Category.comp_id, Category.id_comp] })
320	    (fun γ τ => by
321	      refine Iso.ext ?_
322	      change pullbackGalMap K L g (γ * τ)
323	        = pullbackGalMap K L g τ ≫ pullbackGalMap K L g γ
324	      apply pullback.hom_ext
325	      · rw [Category.assoc, pullbackGalMap_fst, pullbackGalMap_fst, pullbackGalMap_fst]
326	      · rw [Category.assoc, pullbackGalMap_snd, pullbackGalMap_snd,
327	          pullbackGalMap_snd_assoc, toSpecAut_mul_hom])
328	  compat γ := pullback.lift_snd _ _ _
329	
330	@[simp] lemma pullbackSemilinearGalAction_act_hom (γ : L ≃ₐ[K] L) :
331	    ((pullbackSemilinearGalAction K L g).act γ).hom = pullbackGalMap K L g γ := rfl
332	
333	variable {T : Scheme.{u}} (t : T ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of K))
334	
335	/-- The base change to `Spec L` of a morphism over `Spec K`. -/
336	noncomputable abbrev pullbackBaseChange (u : T ⟶ Y) (hu : u ≫ g = t) :
337	    pullback t (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K L)))
338	      ⟶ pullback g (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K L))) :=
339	  pullback.map t _ g _ u (𝟙 _) (𝟙 _) (by rw [Category.comp_id, hu]) (by simp)
340	
341	@[reassoc (attr := simp)]
342	lemma pullbackBaseChange_fst (u : T ⟶ Y) (hu : u ≫ g = t) :
343	    pullbackBaseChange K L g t u hu ≫
344	        pullback.fst g (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K L)))
345	      = pullback.fst t (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K L))) ≫ u :=
346	  pullback.lift_fst _ _ _
347	
348	@[reassoc (attr := simp)]
349	lemma pullbackBaseChange_snd (u : T ⟶ Y) (hu : u ≫ g = t) :
350	    pullbackBaseChange K L g t u hu ≫
351	        pullback.snd g (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K L)))
352	      = pullback.snd t (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K L))) := by
353	  have h : pullbackBaseChange K L g t u hu ≫
354	        pullback.snd g (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K L)))
355	      = pullback.snd t (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K L))) ≫ 𝟙 _ :=
356	    pullback.lift_snd _ _ _
357	  rw [h, Category.comp_id]
358	
359	variable {K L}
360	
361	/-- Naturality of the base-change action: base changes of morphisms over `Spec K`
362	are equivariant for the canonical actions. -/
363	lemma pullbackGalMap_naturality (u : T ⟶ Y) (hu : u ≫ g = t) (γ : L ≃ₐ[K] L) :
364	    pullbackGalMap K L t γ ≫ pullbackBaseChange K L g t u hu
365	      = pullbackBaseChange K L g t u hu ≫ pullbackGalMap K L g γ := by
366	  apply pullback.hom_ext <;> simp
367	
368	/-- The base change of a morphism over `Spec K`, composed with an equivariant
369	morphism, is equivariant.  (The "easy direction" of the `T`-points property of a
370	Galois quotient: descended morphisms induce equivariant ones.) -/
371	theorem SemilinearGalAction.isEquivariant_pullbackBaseChange_comp
372	    {X : Scheme.{u}} {f : X ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of L)}
373	    (ρ : SemilinearGalAction K L X f)
374	    {e : pullback g (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K L))) ⟶ X}
375	    (he : (pullbackSemilinearGalAction K L g).IsEquivariant ρ e)
376	    (u : T ⟶ Y) (hu : u ≫ g = t) :
377	    (pullbackSemilinearGalAction K L t).IsEquivariant ρ
378	      (pullbackBaseChange K L g t u hu ≫ e) := by
379	  intro γ
380	  rw [pullbackSemilinearGalAction_act_hom, ← Category.assoc,
381	    pullbackGalMap_naturality g t u hu γ, Category.assoc, Category.assoc]
382	  exact congrArg _ (he γ)
383	
384	end PullbackAction
385	
386	/-! ## The quotient predicate and the existence gate -/
387	
388	section Quotient
389	
390	variable {K L}
391	variable {X : Scheme.{u}} {f : X ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of L)}
392	
393	/-- `(Y, g)` is a **finite Galois quotient** of the semilinearly-acted `(X, f, ρ)`
394	(campaign `G2`): there is an isomorphism `e : Y ×_{Spec K} Spec L ≅ X` which is
395	
396	1. over `Spec L`,
397	2. `Γ`-equivariant for the canonical base-change action, and
398	3. universal: every equivariant morphism `T ×_{Spec K} Spec L ⟶ X` over `Spec L`
399	   descends **uniquely** to `T ⟶ Y` over `Spec K` — this clause is exactly
400	   `Hom_K(T, Y) ≅ Hom_L(T_L, X)^Γ` (the inverse bijection direction is
401	   `SemilinearGalAction.isEquivariant_pullbackMap_comp`). -/
402	def IsGaloisQuotient (ρ : SemilinearGalAction K L X f) {Y : Scheme.{u}}
403	    (g : Y ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) : Prop :=
404	  ∃ e : pullback g (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K L))) ≅ X,
405	    e.hom ≫ f = pullback.snd g (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K L))) ∧
406	    (pullbackSemilinearGalAction K L g).IsEquivariant ρ e.hom ∧
407	    ∀ (T : Scheme.{u}) (t : T ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of K))
408	      (h : pullback t (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K L))) ⟶ X),
409	      h ≫ f = pullback.snd t (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K L))) →
410	      (pullbackSemilinearGalAction K L t).IsEquivariant ρ h →
411	      ∃! u : {u : T ⟶ Y // u ≫ g = t},
412	        pullbackBaseChange K L g t u.1 u.2 ≫ e.hom = h
413	
414	/-- GATE (campaign `G2`) — existence of the finite Galois quotient under the
415	orbit-in-affine hypothesis.
416	
417	**No longer instance-free, and the qualification matters: it is discharged on the
418	AFFINE locus** (`hasGaloisQuotient_of_isAffine`,
419	`Picard/GaloisQuotientAffineGeneral.lean`, a global `instance`), so for `[IsAffine X]`
420	this class synthesizes outright and subsumes the former single-object witness
421	`hasGaloisQuotient_specF4`. Both measurements below are **from a file importing that
422	module**, which this one is two hops below, so do not expect to reproduce either
423	here: `inferInstance` closes the `𝔽₄` goal, and — the other direction — **fails** for
424	an abstract `ρ` carrying the orbit hypothesis but not affineness, so the remaining
425	content is exactly the non-affine case.
426	
427	Intended discharge of what is left (`G2(c)`): a `Γ`-stable affine cover
428	(`HasStableAffineCover`, from `OrbitsInAffineOpen` via the EGA II 4.5.4 pattern),
429	`Spec (A_U^Γ)` on each stable affine piece by Speiser descent
430	(`SemilinearAlgebras.descentAlgEquiv` — the affine Hom property is
431	`affineGaloisQuotientHomEquiv` below; the per-chart *quotient* is now the affine
432	instance above rather than something to re-derive), glued via `Scheme.GlueData`.
433	The orbit hypothesis is **essential** for that step (Hironaka trap — module
434	docstring), and the affine discharge does not weaken it: an affine `X` has no room
435	for the trap. -/
436	class HasGaloisQuotient [FiniteDimensional K L] [IsGalois K L]
437	    (ρ : SemilinearGalAction K L X f) [ρ.OrbitsInAffineOpen] : Prop where
438	  exists_quotient :
439	    ∃ (Y : Scheme.{u}) (g : Y ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)), IsGaloisQuotient ρ g
440	
441	end Quotient
442	
443	/-! ## The left-factor Galois action on `L ⊗[K] B` -/
444	
445	section TensorAction
446	
447	variable (B : Type u) [CommRing B] [Algebra K B]
448	
449	/-- The left-factor Galois action `γ ↦ γ ⊗ id` on a base change `L ⊗[K] B`.
450	Scoped instance: mathlib carries no action of `L ≃ₐ[K] L` on tensor products, so no
451	diamond can arise; still scoped for hygiene since for `B = L` the *right*-factor
452	action is equally natural. -/
453	noncomputable scoped instance instMulSemiringActionTensor :
454	    MulSemiringAction (L ≃ₐ[K] L) (L ⊗[K] B) where
455	  smul γ x := Algebra.TensorProduct.map (γ : L →ₐ[K] L) (AlgHom.id K B) x
456	  one_smul x := by
457	    change Algebra.TensorProduct.map _ _ x = x
458	    rw [show ((1 : L ≃ₐ[K] L) : L →ₐ[K] L) = AlgHom.id K L from rfl,
459	      Algebra.TensorProduct.map_id, AlgHom.coe_id, id_eq]
460	  mul_smul γ τ x := by
461	    change Algebra.TensorProduct.map _ _ x
462	      = Algebra.TensorProduct.map _ _ (Algebra.TensorProduct.map _ _ x)
463	    rw [← AlgHom.comp_apply, ← Algebra.TensorProduct.map_comp]
464	    rfl
465	  smul_zero γ := map_zero _
466	  smul_add γ := map_add _
467	  smul_one γ := map_one _
468	  smul_mul γ := map_mul _
469	
470	@[simp] lemma galTensor_smul_def (γ : L ≃ₐ[K] L) (x : L ⊗[K] B) :
471	    γ • x = Algebra.TensorProduct.map (γ : L →ₐ[K] L) (AlgHom.id K B) x := rfl
472	
473	/-- The left-factor Galois action on `L ⊗[K] B` is semilinear. -/
474	instance : IsSemilinear K L (L ⊗[K] B) := by
475	  refine SemilinearAction.isSemilinear_of_smul_algebraMap K L _ fun γ a => ?_
476	  change Algebra.TensorProduct.map (γ : L →ₐ[K] L) (AlgHom.id K B)
477	      (algebraMap L (L ⊗[K] B) a) = algebraMap L (L ⊗[K] B) (γ a)
478	  have h : ∀ c : L, algebraMap L (L ⊗[K] B) c = c ⊗ₜ[K] (1 : B) := fun c => rfl
479	  rw [h, h, Algebra.TensorProduct.map_tmul, map_one]
480	  rfl
481	
482	end TensorAction
483	
484	/-! ## Spec-side Hom bookkeeping -/
485	
486	section SpecHoms
487	
488	variable (R S₁ S₂ : Type u) [CommRing R] [CommRing S₁] [CommRing S₂]
489	variable [Algebra R S₁] [Algebra R S₂]
490	
491	/-- Morphisms `Spec S₂ ⟶ Spec S₁` over `Spec R` are `R`-algebra maps `S₁ → S₂`
492	(affine relative Spec adjunction, triangle form). -/
493	noncomputable def specOverEquivAlgHom :
494	    {t : Spec (CommRingCat.of S₂) ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of S₁) //
495	      t ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R S₁))
496	        = Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R S₂))} ≃ (S₁ →ₐ[R] S₂) where
497	  toFun t :=
498	    { toRingHom := (Spec.preimage t.1).hom
499	      commutes' := fun r => by
500	        have h := t.2
501	        rw [← Spec.map_preimage t.1, ← Spec.map_comp] at h
502	        have h2 := congrArg CommRingCat.Hom.hom (Spec.map_injective h)
503	        rw [CommRingCat.hom_comp, CommRingCat.hom_ofHom, CommRingCat.hom_ofHom] at h2
504	        exact DFunLike.congr_fun h2 r }
505	  invFun φ :=
506	    ⟨Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ.toRingHom), by
507	      rw [← Spec.map_comp, ← CommRingCat.ofHom_comp]
508	      congr 1
509	      exact CommRingCat.hom_ext (RingHom.ext fun r => φ.commutes r)⟩
510	  left_inv t := by
511	    apply Subtype.ext
512	    change Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Spec.preimage t.1).hom) = t.1
513	    rw [CommRingCat.ofHom_hom, Spec.map_preimage]
514	  right_inv φ := by
515	    apply AlgHom.ext
516	    intro x
517	    change (Spec.preimage (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ.toRingHom))).hom x = φ x
518	    rw [Spec.preimage_map]
519	    rfl
520	
521	end SpecHoms
522	
523	/-! ## The affine case of the Hom property -/
524	
525	section AffineHomProperty
526	
527	variable (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [Algebra K A] [Algebra L A] [IsScalarTower K L A]
528	variable [MulSemiringAction (L ≃ₐ[K] L) A] [IsSemilinear K L A]
529	variable [FiniteDimensional K L] [IsGalois K L]
530	variable (B : Type u) [CommRing B] [Algebra K B]
531	
532	open SemilinearAction
533	
534	omit [Algebra K A] [IsScalarTower K L A] [IsSemilinear K L A]
535	  [FiniteDimensional K L] [IsGalois K L] in
536	/-- Equivariance of an `L`-algebra map matches equivariance of the corresponding
537	morphism of affine schemes (with the `toSpecAut` actions on both sides). -/
538	lemma isEquivariantAlgHom_iff_specMap (φ : A →ₐ[L] L ⊗[K] B) :
539	    IsEquivariantAlgHom K L A B φ ↔
540	      ∀ γ : L ≃ₐ[K] L,
541	        (toSpecAut (L ≃ₐ[K] L) (L ⊗[K] B) γ).hom ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ.toRingHom)
542	          = Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ.toRingHom) ≫ (toSpecAut (L ≃ₐ[K] L) A γ).hom := by
543	  have key : ∀ γ : L ≃ₐ[K] L,
544	      ((toSpecAut (L ≃ₐ[K] L) (L ⊗[K] B) γ).hom ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ.toRingHom)
545	          = Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ.toRingHom) ≫ (toSpecAut (L ≃ₐ[K] L) A γ).hom)
546	        ↔ ∀ x : A, γ⁻¹ • φ x = φ (γ⁻¹ • x) := by
547	    intro γ
548	    rw [toSpecAut_hom, toSpecAut_hom, ← Spec.map_comp, ← Spec.map_comp,
549	      ← CommRingCat.ofHom_comp, ← CommRingCat.ofHom_comp]
550	    constructor
551	    · intro h
552	      have h2 := congrArg CommRingCat.Hom.hom (Spec.map_injective h)
553	      rw [CommRingCat.hom_ofHom, CommRingCat.hom_ofHom] at h2
554	      exact fun x => DFunLike.congr_fun h2 x
555	    · intro h
556	      congr 1
557	      exact CommRingCat.hom_ext (RingHom.ext h)
558	  constructor
559	  · intro hφ γ
560	    rw [key γ]
561	    intro x
562	    rw [galTensor_smul_def, ← hφ γ⁻¹ x]
563	  · intro hs γ x
564	    have h3 := (key γ⁻¹).mp (hs γ⁻¹) x
565	    rw [inv_inv, galTensor_smul_def] at h3
566	    exact h3.symm
567	
568	open Algebra in
569	/-- **The affine case of the Galois quotient Hom property** (campaign `G2(b)`,
570	scheme form, affine `T`).  For `X' = Spec A` with a semilinear `Γ`-action and any
571	affine `T = Spec B` over `Spec K` (with `T ×_{Spec K} Spec L = Spec (L ⊗[K] B)`):
572	morphisms `T ⟶ Spec (A^Γ)` over `Spec K` correspond to `Γ`-equivariant morphisms
573	`Spec (L ⊗[K] B) ⟶ Spec A` over `Spec L`.  Proved by Speiser descent
574	(`invariantAlgHomEquiv`), never via invariant finiteness. -/
575	noncomputable def affineGaloisQuotientHomEquiv :
576	    {t : Spec (CommRingCat.of B) ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of (invariantsSubalgebra K L A)) //
577	      t ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K (invariantsSubalgebra K L A)))
578	        = Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K B))} ≃
579	    {h : Spec (CommRingCat.of (L ⊗[K] B)) ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of A) //
580	      (h ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap L A))
581	          = Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap L (L ⊗[K] B)))) ∧
582	      ∀ γ : L ≃ₐ[K] L,
583	        (toSpecAut (L ≃ₐ[K] L) (L ⊗[K] B) γ).hom ≫ h
584	          = h ≫ (toSpecAut (L ≃ₐ[K] L) A γ).hom} :=
585	  ((specOverEquivAlgHom K (invariantsSubalgebra K L A) B).trans
586	    ((invariantAlgHomEquiv K L A B).trans
587	      ((Equiv.subtypeEquiv (specOverEquivAlgHom L A (L ⊗[K] B)).symm
588	        (fun φ => isEquivariantAlgHom_iff_specMap K L A B φ)).trans
589	        (Equiv.subtypeSubtypeEquivSubtypeInter _ _))))
590	
591	end AffineHomProperty
592	
593	end AlgebraicJacobian.GaloisDescent

6	import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.FiniteGaloisQuotientAffine
7	import Mathlib.AlgebraicGeometry.Morphisms.Flat
8	
9	/-!
10	# Uniqueness of finite Galois quotients
11	
12	The universal `T`-points clause in `IsGaloisQuotient` determines the quotient
13	scheme uniquely over the base.  This file packages that observation as a
14	canonical comparison morphism and isomorphism.  The transitivity theorem is the
15	cocycle engine for gluing affine Galois quotient charts: once two restrictions
16	are known to be quotients of the same acted scheme, their overlap isomorphism
17	and every triple-overlap identity follow from uniqueness.
18	-/
19	
20	open CategoryTheory Limits AlgebraicGeometry
21	
22	universe u
23	
24	namespace AlgebraicJacobian.GaloisDescent
25	
26	/-- The data asserted by `IsGaloisQuotient`, retained in `Type` so its universal
27	property can define comparison morphisms. -/
28	structure GaloisQuotientWitness
29	    {K L : Type u} [Field K] [Field L] [Algebra K L]
30	    {X : Scheme.{u}} {f : X ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of L)}
31	    (rho : SemilinearGalAction K L X f)
32	    (Y : Scheme.{u}) (g : Y ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) where
33	  e : pullback g (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K L))) ≅ X
34	  over : e.hom ≫ f = pullback.snd g (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K L)))
35	  equivariant : (pullbackSemilinearGalAction K L g).IsEquivariant rho e.hom
36	  universal : ∀ (T : Scheme.{u}) (t : T ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of K))
37	      (h : pullback t (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K L))) ⟶ X),
38	      h ≫ f = pullback.snd t (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K L))) →
39	      (pullbackSemilinearGalAction K L t).IsEquivariant rho h →
40	      ∃! v : {v : T ⟶ Y // v ≫ g = t},
41	        pullbackBaseChange K L g t v.1 v.2 ≫ e.hom = h
42	
43	/-- A quotient witness together with the quotient projection induced by its
44	pinned base-change isomorphism. -/
45	structure GaloisQuotientWitnessWithProjection
46	    {K L : Type u} [Field K] [Field L] [Algebra K L]
47	    {X : Scheme.{u}} {f : X ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of L)}
48	    (rho : SemilinearGalAction K L X f)
49	    (Y : Scheme.{u}) (g : Y ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of K))
50	    (q : X ⟶ Y) extends GaloisQuotientWitness rho Y g where
51	  projection : e.inv ≫ pullback.fst g
52	    (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K L))) = q

56	/-- The comparison morphism defined from two specified quotient witnesses. -/
57	noncomputable def comparison
58	    {K L : Type u} [Field K] [Field L] [Algebra K L]
59	    {X : Scheme.{u}} {f : X ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of L)}
60	    {rho : SemilinearGalAction K L X f}
61	    {Y₁ Y₂ : Scheme.{u}}
62	    {g₁ : Y₁ ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)}
63	    {g₂ : Y₂ ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)}
64	    (w₁ : GaloisQuotientWitness rho Y₁ g₁)
65	    (w₂ : GaloisQuotientWitness rho Y₂ g₂) :
66	    {v : Y₁ ⟶ Y₂ // v ≫ g₂ = g₁} :=
67	  (w₂.universal Y₁ g₁ w₁.e.hom w₁.over w₁.equivariant).choose
68	
69	/-- Base change of a witness-level comparison identifies the two pinned
70	base-change isomorphisms. -/
71	theorem comparison_spec
72	    {K L : Type u} [Field K] [Field L] [Algebra K L]
73	    {X : Scheme.{u}} {f : X ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of L)}
74	    {rho : SemilinearGalAction K L X f}
75	    {Y₁ Y₂ : Scheme.{u}}
76	    {g₁ : Y₁ ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)}
77	    {g₂ : Y₂ ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)}
78	    (w₁ : GaloisQuotientWitness rho Y₁ g₁)
79	    (w₂ : GaloisQuotientWitness rho Y₂ g₂) :
80	    pullbackBaseChange K L g₂ g₁ (comparison w₁ w₂).1
81	        (comparison w₁ w₂).2 ≫ w₂.e.hom = w₁.e.hom :=
82	  (w₂.universal Y₁ g₁ w₁.e.hom w₁.over w₁.equivariant).choose_spec.1
83	
84	/-- A witness-level comparison intertwines the quotient projections determined
85	by the two pinned base-change isomorphisms. -/
86	theorem comparison_projection
87	    {K L : Type u} [Field K] [Field L] [Algebra K L]
88	    {X : Scheme.{u}} {f : X ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of L)}
89	    {rho : SemilinearGalAction K L X f}
90	    {Y₁ Y₂ : Scheme.{u}}
91	    {g₁ : Y₁ ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)}
92	    {g₂ : Y₂ ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)}
93	    (w₁ : GaloisQuotientWitness rho Y₁ g₁)
94	    (w₂ : GaloisQuotientWitness rho Y₂ g₂) :
95	    (w₁.e.inv ≫ pullback.fst g₁
96	      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K L)))) ≫
97	        (comparison w₁ w₂).1 =
98	      w₂.e.inv ≫ pullback.fst g₂
99	        (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K L))) := by
100	  let v := comparison w₁ w₂
101	  let bc := pullbackBaseChange K L g₂ g₁ v.1 v.2
102	  have hinv : w₁.e.inv ≫ bc = w₂.e.inv := by
103	    rw [← cancel_mono w₂.e.hom]
104	    dsimp only [bc, v]
105	    simp only [Category.assoc, comparison_spec]
106	    simp
107	  calc
108	    (w₁.e.inv ≫ pullback.fst g₁
109	        (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K L)))) ≫ v.1 =
110	        w₁.e.inv ≫
111	          (pullbackBaseChange K L g₂ g₁ v.1 v.2 ≫
112	            pullback.fst g₂
113	              (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K L)))) := by
114	      rw [pullbackBaseChange_fst]
115	      simp only [Category.assoc]
116	    _ = (w₁.e.inv ≫ bc) ≫ pullback.fst g₂
117	        (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K L))) := by
118	      rfl
119	    _ = w₂.e.inv ≫ pullback.fst g₂
120	        (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K L))) := by rw [hinv]
121	
122	/-- Comparing witnesses with specified quotient projections intertwines those
123	projections. -/
124	theorem comparison_quotientMap
125	    {K L : Type u} [Field K] [Field L] [Algebra K L]
126	    {X : Scheme.{u}} {f : X ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of L)}
127	    {rho : SemilinearGalAction K L X f}
128	    {Y₁ Y₂ : Scheme.{u}}
129	    {g₁ : Y₁ ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)}
130	    {g₂ : Y₂ ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)}
131	    {q₁ : X ⟶ Y₁} {q₂ : X ⟶ Y₂}
132	    (w₁ : GaloisQuotientWitnessWithProjection rho Y₁ g₁ q₁)
133	    (w₂ : GaloisQuotientWitnessWithProjection rho Y₂ g₂ q₂) :
134	    q₁ ≫ (comparison w₁.toGaloisQuotientWitness
135	      w₂.toGaloisQuotientWitness).1 = q₂ := by
136	  calc
137	    q₁ ≫ (comparison w₁.toGaloisQuotientWitness
138	        w₂.toGaloisQuotientWitness).1 =
139	        (w₁.e.inv ≫ pullback.fst g₁
140	          (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K L)))) ≫
141	          (comparison w₁.toGaloisQuotientWitness
142	            w₂.toGaloisQuotientWitness).1 :=
143	      congrArg (fun z => z ≫ (comparison w₁.toGaloisQuotientWitness
144	        w₂.toGaloisQuotientWitness).1) w₁.projection.symm
145	    _ = w₂.e.inv ≫ pullback.fst g₂
146	        (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K L))) :=
147	      comparison_projection w₁.toGaloisQuotientWitness
148	        w₂.toGaloisQuotientWitness
149	    _ = q₂ := w₂.projection

151	/-- Transport a specified quotient witness along an equivariant isomorphism of
152	the acted source schemes. -/
153	noncomputable def transport
154	    {K L : Type u} [Field K] [Field L] [Algebra K L]
155	    {X X' : Scheme.{u}}
156	    {f : X ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of L)}
157	    {f' : X' ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of L)}
158	    (rho : SemilinearGalAction K L X f)
159	    (rho' : SemilinearGalAction K L X' f')
160	    (e : X ≅ X') (hef : e.hom ≫ f' = f)
161	    (he : rho.IsEquivariant rho' e.hom)
162	    {Y : Scheme.{u}} {g : Y ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)}
163	    (w : GaloisQuotientWitness rho' Y g) :
164	    GaloisQuotientWitness rho Y g := by
165	  refine ⟨w.e ≪≫ e.symm, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
166	  · rw [Iso.trans_hom, Category.assoc, ← hef, Iso.symm_hom,
167	      Iso.inv_hom_id_assoc, w.over]
168	  · intro γ
169	    have hinv : e.inv ≫ (rho.act γ).hom = (rho'.act γ).hom ≫ e.inv := by
170	      rw [Iso.inv_comp_eq, ← Category.assoc, ← he γ, Category.assoc,
171	        Iso.hom_inv_id, Category.comp_id]
172	    change _ ≫ w.e.hom ≫ e.inv = (w.e.hom ≫ e.inv) ≫ _
173	    rw [← Category.assoc, w.equivariant γ, Category.assoc, Category.assoc, hinv]
174	  · intro T t h hover hequiv
175	    obtain ⟨v, hv, hvuniq⟩ := w.universal T t (h ≫ e.hom)
176	      (by rw [Category.assoc, hef, hover])
177	      (by
178	        intro γ
179	        rw [← Category.assoc, hequiv γ, Category.assoc, he γ, Category.assoc])
180	    refine ⟨v, ?_, fun y hy => hvuniq y ?_⟩
181	    · change _ ≫ w.e.hom ≫ e.inv = h
182	      rw [← Category.assoc, hv, Category.assoc, Iso.hom_inv_id, Category.comp_id]
183	    · change _ ≫ w.e.hom = h ≫ e.hom
184	      have hy' : pullbackBaseChange K L g t y.1 y.2 ≫
185	          w.e.hom ≫ e.inv = h := hy
186	      rw [← Category.assoc] at hy'
187	      rw [← hy', Category.assoc, Iso.inv_hom_id, Category.comp_id]
188	
189	/-- Comparing a specified quotient witness with itself gives the identity. -/
190	theorem comparison_self
191	    {K L : Type u} [Field K] [Field L] [Algebra K L]
192	    {X : Scheme.{u}} {f : X ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of L)}
193	    {rho : SemilinearGalAction K L X f}
194	    {Y : Scheme.{u}} {g : Y ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)}
195	    (w : GaloisQuotientWitness rho Y g) :
196	    (comparison w w).1 = 𝟙 Y := by
197	  classical
198	  have hbc : pullbackBaseChange K L g g (𝟙 Y) (Category.id_comp g) = 𝟙 _ := by
199	    apply pullback.hom_ext <;> simp
200	  have hid : pullbackBaseChange K L g g (𝟙 Y) (Category.id_comp g) ≫
201	      w.e.hom = w.e.hom := by rw [hbc, Category.id_comp]
202	  have heq := (w.universal Y g w.e.hom w.over w.equivariant).unique
203	    (y₁ := comparison w w) (y₂ := ⟨𝟙 Y, Category.id_comp g⟩)
204	    (comparison_spec w w) hid
205	  exact congrArg Subtype.val heq
206	
207	/-- Comparisons of specified quotient witnesses compose transitively. -/
208	theorem comparison_comp
209	    {K L : Type u} [Field K] [Field L] [Algebra K L]
210	    {X : Scheme.{u}} {f : X ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of L)}
211	    {rho : SemilinearGalAction K L X f}
212	    {Y₁ Y₂ Y₃ : Scheme.{u}}
213	    {g₁ : Y₁ ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)}
214	    {g₂ : Y₂ ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)}
215	    {g₃ : Y₃ ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)}
216	    (w₁ : GaloisQuotientWitness rho Y₁ g₁)
217	    (w₂ : GaloisQuotientWitness rho Y₂ g₂)
218	    (w₃ : GaloisQuotientWitness rho Y₃ g₃) :
219	    (comparison w₁ w₂).1 ≫ (comparison w₂ w₃).1 =
220	      (comparison w₁ w₃).1 := by
221	  classical
222	  let v₁₂ := comparison w₁ w₂
223	  let v₂₃ := comparison w₂ w₃
224	  have hbase : (v₁₂.1 ≫ v₂₃.1) ≫ g₃ = g₁ := by
225	    rw [Category.assoc, v₂₃.2, v₁₂.2]
226	  have hcomp : pullbackBaseChange K L g₃ g₁ (v₁₂.1 ≫ v₂₃.1) hbase ≫
227	      w₃.e.hom = w₁.e.hom := by
228	    rw [pullbackBaseChange_comp K L g₃ g₂ g₁ v₂₃.1 v₂₃.2 v₁₂.1 v₁₂.2,
229	      Category.assoc, comparison_spec w₂ w₃, comparison_spec w₁ w₂]
230	  have heq := (w₃.universal Y₁ g₁ w₁.e.hom w₁.over w₁.equivariant).unique
231	    (y₁ := ⟨v₁₂.1 ≫ v₂₃.1, hbase⟩) (y₂ := comparison w₁ w₃)
232	    hcomp (comparison_spec w₁ w₃)
233	  exact congrArg Subtype.val heq

235	/-- The canonical isomorphism determined by two specified quotient witnesses. -/
236	noncomputable def uniqueIso
237	    {K L : Type u} [Field K] [Field L] [Algebra K L]
238	    {X : Scheme.{u}} {f : X ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of L)}
239	    {rho : SemilinearGalAction K L X f}
240	    {Y₁ Y₂ : Scheme.{u}}
241	    {g₁ : Y₁ ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)}
242	    {g₂ : Y₂ ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)}

245	  hom := (comparison w₁ w₂).1
246	  inv := (comparison w₂ w₁).1
247	  hom_inv_id := by rw [comparison_comp, comparison_self]

254	/-- The pinned quotient projection lies over the base field. -/
255	@[reassoc]
256	theorem quotientMap_comp_base
257	    {K L : Type u} [Field K] [Field L] [Algebra K L]
258	    {X : Scheme.{u}} {f : X ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of L)}
259	    {rho : SemilinearGalAction K L X f}

261	    {q : X ⟶ Y}
262	    (w : GaloisQuotientWitnessWithProjection rho Y g q) :
263	    q ≫ g = f ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K L)) := by
264	  rw [← w.projection]
265	  simp only [Category.assoc]
266	  rw [pullback.condition]
267	  rw [← w.over]
268	  simp

270	/-- The inverse of the pinned base-change isomorphism has the source structure
271	map as its second projection. -/
272	@[reassoc]
273	theorem inverse_comp_snd
274	    {K L : Type u} [Field K] [Field L] [Algebra K L]
275	    {X : Scheme.{u}} {f : X ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of L)}
276	    {rho : SemilinearGalAction K L X f}
277	    {Y : Scheme.{u}} {g : Y ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)}
278	    {q : X ⟶ Y}
279	    (w : GaloisQuotientWitnessWithProjection rho Y g q) :

281	        (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K L))) = f := by

285	/-- The pinned quotient projection is invariant under the Galois action. -/
286	@[reassoc]
287	theorem act_hom_comp_quotientMap
288	    {K L : Type u} [Field K] [Field L] [Algebra K L]
289	    {X : Scheme.{u}} {f : X ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of L)}
290	    {rho : SemilinearGalAction K L X f}
291	    {Y : Scheme.{u}} {g : Y ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)}
292	    {q : X ⟶ Y}
293	    (w : GaloisQuotientWitnessWithProjection rho Y g q)
294	    (gamma : L ≃ₐ[K] L) :
295	    (rho.act gamma).hom ≫ q = q := by
296	  have hinv : (rho.act gamma).hom ≫ w.e.inv =
297	      w.e.inv ≫
298	        ((pullbackSemilinearGalAction K L g).act gamma).hom := by
299	    rw [← cancel_mono w.e.hom]
300	    simp only [Category.assoc, Iso.inv_hom_id, Category.comp_id]
301	    calc
302	      (rho.act gamma).hom =
303	          (w.e.inv ≫ w.e.hom) ≫ (rho.act gamma).hom := by simp
304	      _ = w.e.inv ≫ (w.e.hom ≫ (rho.act gamma).hom) :=
305	        Category.assoc _ _ _
306	      _ = w.e.inv ≫
307	          (((pullbackSemilinearGalAction K L g).act gamma).hom ≫
308	            w.e.hom) :=
309	        congrArg (fun z ↦ w.e.inv ≫ z) (w.equivariant gamma).symm
310	      _ = (w.e.inv ≫
311	          ((pullbackSemilinearGalAction K L g).act gamma).hom) ≫
312	            w.e.hom := (Category.assoc _ _ _).symm
313	  rw [← w.projection, ← Category.assoc, hinv, Category.assoc]
314	  rw [pullbackSemilinearGalAction_act_hom, pullbackGalMap_fst]

316	/-- The quotient projection specified by a Galois quotient witness is an
317	epimorphism.  It is an isomorphism followed by the flat surjective base change
318	of `Spec L ⟶ Spec K`. -/
319	theorem epi_quotientMap
320	    {K L : Type u} [Field K] [Field L] [Algebra K L]
321	    {X : Scheme.{u}} {f : X ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of L)}
322	    {rho : SemilinearGalAction K L X f}
323	    {Y : Scheme.{u}} {g : Y ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)}
324	    {q : X ⟶ Y}
325	    (w : GaloisQuotientWitnessWithProjection rho Y g q) : Epi q := by
326	  let base : Spec (CommRingCat.of L) ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of K) :=
327	    Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K L))
328	  letI : Surjective base :=
329	    ⟨fun _ => ⟨default, Subsingleton.elim _ _⟩⟩
330	  haveI : Epi (pullback.fst g base) :=
331	    Flat.epi_of_flat_of_surjective _
332	  rw [← w.projection]
333	  infer_instance

335	/-- Transport a projection-carrying quotient witness along an equivariant
336	isomorphism of acted source schemes. -/
337	noncomputable def transport
338	    {K L : Type u} [Field K] [Field L] [Algebra K L]
339	    {X X' : Scheme.{u}}
340	    {f : X ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of L)}
341	    {f' : X' ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of L)}
342	    (rho : SemilinearGalAction K L X f)
343	    (rho' : SemilinearGalAction K L X' f')
344	    (e : X ≅ X') (hef : e.hom ≫ f' = f)
345	    (he : rho.IsEquivariant rho' e.hom)
346	    {Y : Scheme.{u}} {g : Y ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)}

352	  dsimp [GaloisQuotientWitness.transport]
353	  simp only [Iso.trans_inv, Iso.symm_inv, Category.assoc]
354	  rw [w.projection]

401	/-- Comparing a quotient with itself gives the identity morphism. -/
402	theorem quotientComparison_self
403	    {K L : Type u} [Field K] [Field L] [Algebra K L]
404	    {X : Scheme.{u}} {f : X ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of L)}
405	    (rho : SemilinearGalAction K L X f)
406	    {Y : Scheme.{u}} {g : Y ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)}
407	    (h : IsGaloisQuotient rho g) :
408	    (quotientComparison rho h h).1 = 𝟙 Y := by
409	  classical
410	  have hbc : pullbackBaseChange K L g g (𝟙 Y) (Category.id_comp g) = 𝟙 _ := by
411	    apply pullback.hom_ext <;> simp
412	  have hid : pullbackBaseChange K L g g (𝟙 Y) (Category.id_comp g) ≫
413	      (h.witness).e.hom = (h.witness).e.hom := by rw [hbc, Category.id_comp]
414	  have heq := ((h.witness).universal Y g (h.witness).e.hom (h.witness).over
415	    (h.witness).equivariant).unique
416	      (y₁ := quotientComparison rho h h) (y₂ := ⟨𝟙 Y, Category.id_comp g⟩)
417	      (quotientComparison_spec rho h h) hid

420	/-- Comparison morphisms compose transitively.  This is the triple-overlap
421	cocycle identity used by quotient gluing. -/
422	theorem quotientComparison_comp
423	    {K L : Type u} [Field K] [Field L] [Algebra K L]
424	    {X : Scheme.{u}} {f : X ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of L)}
425	    (rho : SemilinearGalAction K L X f)
426	    {Y₁ Y₂ Y₃ : Scheme.{u}}
427	    {g₁ : Y₁ ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)}
428	    {g₂ : Y₂ ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)}
429	    {g₃ : Y₃ ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)}
430	    (h₁ : IsGaloisQuotient rho g₁) (h₂ : IsGaloisQuotient rho g₂)
431	    (h₃ : IsGaloisQuotient rho g₃) :
432	    (quotientComparison rho h₁ h₂).1 ≫ (quotientComparison rho h₂ h₃).1 =
433	      (quotientComparison rho h₁ h₃).1 := by
434	  classical
435	  let v₁₂ := quotientComparison rho h₁ h₂
436	  let v₂₃ := quotientComparison rho h₂ h₃
437	  have hbase : (v₁₂.1 ≫ v₂₃.1) ≫ g₃ = g₁ := by
438	    rw [Category.assoc, v₂₃.2, v₁₂.2]
439	  have hcomp : pullbackBaseChange K L g₃ g₁ (v₁₂.1 ≫ v₂₃.1) hbase ≫
440	      (h₃.witness).e.hom = (h₁.witness).e.hom := by
441	    rw [pullbackBaseChange_comp K L g₃ g₂ g₁ v₂₃.1 v₂₃.2 v₁₂.1 v₁₂.2,
442	      Category.assoc, quotientComparison_spec rho h₂ h₃,
443	      quotientComparison_spec rho h₁ h₂]
444	  have heq := ((h₃.witness).universal Y₁ g₁ (h₁.witness).e.hom (h₁.witness).over
445	    (h₁.witness).equivariant).unique
446	      (y₁ := ⟨v₁₂.1 ≫ v₂₃.1, hbase⟩) (y₂ := quotientComparison rho h₁ h₃)
447	      hcomp (quotientComparison_spec rho h₁ h₃)
448	  exact congrArg Subtype.val heq
449	
450	/-- Any two schemes representing the same finite Galois quotient are
451	canonically isomorphic over `Spec K`. -/
452	noncomputable def quotientUniqueIso
453	    {K L : Type u} [Field K] [Field L] [Algebra K L]
454	    {X : Scheme.{u}} {f : X ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of L)}
455	    (rho : SemilinearGalAction K L X f)
456	    {Y₁ Y₂ : Scheme.{u}}
457	    {g₁ : Y₁ ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)}
458	    {g₂ : Y₂ ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)}
459	    (h₁ : IsGaloisQuotient rho g₁) (h₂ : IsGaloisQuotient rho g₂) : Y₁ ≅ Y₂ where
460	  hom := (quotientComparison rho h₁ h₂).1
461	  inv := (quotientComparison rho h₂ h₁).1
462	  hom_inv_id := by rw [quotientComparison_comp, quotientComparison_self]
463	  inv_hom_id := by rw [quotientComparison_comp, quotientComparison_self]
464	
465	@[reassoc]
466	theorem quotientUniqueIso_hom_base
467	    {K L : Type u} [Field K] [Field L] [Algebra K L]
468	    {X : Scheme.{u}} {f : X ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of L)}
469	    (rho : SemilinearGalAction K L X f)
470	    {Y₁ Y₂ : Scheme.{u}}
471	    {g₁ : Y₁ ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)}
472	    {g₂ : Y₂ ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)}
473	    (h₁ : IsGaloisQuotient rho g₁) (h₂ : IsGaloisQuotient rho g₂) :
474	    (quotientUniqueIso rho h₁ h₂).hom ≫ g₂ = g₁ :=
475	  (quotientComparison rho h₁ h₂).2
476	
477	@[reassoc]
478	theorem quotientUniqueIso_inv_base
479	    {K L : Type u} [Field K] [Field L] [Algebra K L]
480	    {X : Scheme.{u}} {f : X ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of L)}
481	    (rho : SemilinearGalAction K L X f)
482	    {Y₁ Y₂ : Scheme.{u}}
483	    {g₁ : Y₁ ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)}
484	    {g₂ : Y₂ ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)}
485	    (h₁ : IsGaloisQuotient rho g₁) (h₂ : IsGaloisQuotient rho g₂) :
486	    (quotientUniqueIso rho h₁ h₂).inv ≫ g₁ = g₂ :=
487	  (quotientComparison rho h₂ h₁).2
488	
489	/-- The hom maps of the canonical quotient isomorphisms satisfy the gluing
490	cocycle on triple overlaps. -/
491	theorem quotientUniqueIso_hom_trans
492	    {K L : Type u} [Field K] [Field L] [Algebra K L]
493	    {X : Scheme.{u}} {f : X ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of L)}
494	    (rho : SemilinearGalAction K L X f)
495	    {Y₁ Y₂ Y₃ : Scheme.{u}}
496	    {g₁ : Y₁ ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)}
497	    {g₂ : Y₂ ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)}
498	    {g₃ : Y₃ ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)}
499	    (h₁ : IsGaloisQuotient rho g₁) (h₂ : IsGaloisQuotient rho g₂)
500	    (h₃ : IsGaloisQuotient rho g₃) :
501	    (quotientUniqueIso rho h₁ h₂).hom ≫ (quotientUniqueIso rho h₂ h₃).hom =
502	      (quotientUniqueIso rho h₁ h₃).hom :=
503	  quotientComparison_comp rho h₁ h₂ h₃
504	
505	@[simp]
506	theorem quotientUniqueIso_self
507	    {K L : Type u} [Field K] [Field L] [Algebra K L]
508	    {X : Scheme.{u}} {f : X ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of L)}
509	    (rho : SemilinearGalAction K L X f)
510	    {Y : Scheme.{u}} {g : Y ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)}
511	    (h : IsGaloisQuotient rho g) : quotientUniqueIso rho h h = Iso.refl Y := by
512	  ext
513	  exact quotientComparison_self rho h
514

11	/-!
12	# Overlap charts for a finite Galois quotient
13	
14	This file packages the invariant-ring quotient charts attached to stable affine
15	opens and their quotient-side overlaps.  Every overlap carries the full
16	`IsGaloisQuotient` witness for the restricted action.  The reversed overlap
17	comparison is then canonical by uniqueness.
18	-/

34	/-- Equality of stable opens induces an equivariant isomorphism between the
35	corresponding restricted actions. -/
36	theorem restrict_isoOfEq_isEquivariant {U V : X.Opens}
37	    (hU : ρ.IsStableOpen U) (hV : ρ.IsStableOpen V) (e : U = V) :
38	    (ρ.restrict hU).IsEquivariant (ρ.restrict hV) (X.isoOfEq e).hom := by
39	  intro γ
40	  rw [restrict_act_hom, restrict_act_hom]
41	  rw [← cancel_mono V.ι]
42	  simp

44	end SemilinearGalAction

46	/-- A stable affine open for a fixed semilinear Galois action. -/

48	    {K L : Type u} [Field K] [Field L] [Algebra K L]

50	    (ρ : SemilinearGalAction K L X f) where
51	  U : X.Opens

53	  stable : ρ.IsStableOpen U

61	/-- The intersection of two stable opens is stable. -/
62	theorem inf_stable (i j : StableAffineOpen ρ) :
63	    ρ.IsStableOpen (i.U ⊓ j.U) := by
64	  intro γ
65	  rw [Scheme.Hom.preimage_inf, i.stable γ, j.stable γ]

67	/-- The open cover of the acted scheme indexed by all stable affine opens.
68	The existing `HasStableAffineCover` producer supplies joint surjectivity. -/
69	noncomputable def sourceOpenCover [HasStableAffineCover K L ρ] :
70	    Scheme.OpenCover X where
71	  I₀ := StableAffineOpen ρ
72	  X i := i.U.toScheme
73	  f i := i.U.ι
74	  mem₀ := by
75	    rw [Scheme.presieve₀_mem_precoverage_iff]
76	    constructor
77	    · intro x
78	      obtain ⟨U, hUa, hx, hU⟩ :=
79	        HasStableAffineCover.exists_stable_affineOpen (ρ := ρ) x
80	      exact ⟨⟨U, hUa, hU⟩, ⟨x, hx⟩, rfl⟩
81	    · intro i
82	      infer_instance

85	noncomputable def quotientChart (i : StableAffineOpen ρ) : Scheme.{u} := by
86	  letI := ρ.sectionsMulSemiringAction i.stable
87	  letI := SemilinearGalAction.sectionsAlgebra f i.U
88	  letI := SemilinearGalAction.sectionsAlgebraK (K := K) f i.U
89	  letI := SemilinearGalAction.sections_isScalarTower (K := K) f i.U
90	  letI := ρ.isSemilinear_sections i.stable
91	  exact Spec (CommRingCat.of
92	    (SemilinearAction.invariantsSubalgebra K L Γ(X, i.U)))

306	    (i j k : StableAffineOpen ρ) :
307	    letI := ρ.sectionsMulSemiringAction i.stable
308	    letI := SemilinearGalAction.sectionsAlgebra f i.U
309	    letI := SemilinearGalAction.sectionsAlgebraK (K := K) f i.U

319	  letI := SemilinearGalAction.sections_isScalarTower (K := K) f i.U

321	  exact SemilinearGalAction.quotientOpenOfStableSubopen_mono
322	    ρ i.stable i.affine

11	/-!
12	# Descent of finite Galois quotient morphisms
13	
14	The graph charts of a finite Galois action cover the kernel pair of every
15	finite Galois field extension.  Consequently, an equivariant morphism followed
16	by an invariant quotient projection equalizes that kernel pair.  Effective
17	descent along the finite faithfully flat field cover then supplies the full
18	universal property required by `IsGaloisQuotient`.
19	-/
20	
21	open CategoryTheory Limits AlgebraicGeometry
22	
23	universe u
24	
25	namespace AlgebraicJacobian.GaloisDescent
26	
27	open AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.PicScheme
28	
29	variable {K L : Type u} [Field K] [Field L] [Algebra K L]
30	  [FiniteDimensional K L] [IsGalois K L]
31	  {X Y : Scheme.{u}} {f : X ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of L)}
32	  (rho : SemilinearGalAction K L X f) (q : X ⟶ Y)
33	
34	set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false in
35	/-- Equivariance and invariance of the quotient projection imply equality on
36	the two projections of the field-cover kernel pair. -/
37	theorem kernelPair_eq_of_equivariant
38	    (hqinv : ∀ gamma : L ≃ₐ[K] L, (rho.act gamma).hom ≫ q = q)
39	    (T : Scheme.{u}) (t : T ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of K))
40	    (h : pullback t (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K L))) ⟶ X)
41	    (_hoverh : h ≫ f =
42	      pullback.snd t (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K L))))
43	    (hequivh : (pullbackSemilinearGalAction K L t).IsEquivariant rho h) :
44	    pullback.fst
45	          (pullback.fst t (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K L))))
46	          (pullback.fst t (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K L)))) ≫
47	        h ≫ q =
48	      pullback.snd
49	          (pullback.fst t (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K L))))
50	          (pullback.fst t (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K L)))) ≫
51	        h ≫ q := by
52	  let base : Spec (CommRingCat.of L) ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of K) :=
53	    Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K L))
54	  let T' : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) := Over.mk t
55	  let c := coverMap (k := K) (k' := L) T'
56	  let E := PreservesPullback.iso (Over.forget (Spec (CommRingCat.of K))) c c
57	  have hc : (Over.forget (Spec (CommRingCat.of K))).map c =
58	      pullback.fst t (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K L))) := rfl
59	  let Ec := pullback.congrHom hc hc
60	  let E' := E ≪≫ Ec
61	  apply (cancel_epi E'.hom).1
62	  apply coverSelfSection_hom_ext T'
63	  intro gamma
64	  simp only [E', E, Ec, Iso.trans_hom, Category.assoc,
65	    pullback.congrHom_hom, pullback.lift_fst_assoc, pullback.lift_snd_assoc,
66	    Category.comp_id, PreservesPullback.iso_hom_fst_assoc,
67	    PreservesPullback.iso_hom_snd_assoc]
68	  simp only [Over.forget_map]
69	  dsimp only [c]
70	  have hfst := congrArg Over.Hom.left
71	    (coverSelfSection_fst (k := K) (k' := L) T' gamma)
72	  have hsnd := congrArg Over.Hom.left
73	    (coverSelfSection_snd (k := K) (k' := L) T' gamma)
74	  simp only [Over.comp_left, Over.id_left] at hfst hsnd
75	  simp only [← Category.assoc, hfst, hsnd, Category.id_comp]
76	  change h ≫ q = twistLeft T' gamma ≫ h ≫ q
77	  have htwist : twistLeft T' gamma = pullbackGalMap K L t gamma⁻¹ := rfl
78	  have heq : pullbackGalMap K L t gamma⁻¹ ≫ h =
79	      h ≫ (rho.act gamma⁻¹).hom := by
80	    simpa only [pullbackSemilinearGalAction_act_hom] using hequivh gamma⁻¹
81	  symm
82	  calc
83	    twistLeft T' gamma ≫ h ≫ q =
84	        pullbackGalMap K L t gamma⁻¹ ≫ h ≫ q :=
85	      congrArg (fun m => m ≫ h ≫ q) htwist
86	    _ = (pullbackGalMap K L t gamma⁻¹ ≫ h) ≫ q :=
87	      (Category.assoc _ _ _).symm
88	    _ = (h ≫ (rho.act gamma⁻¹).hom) ≫ q :=
89	      congrArg (fun m => m ≫ q) heq
90	    _ = h ≫ ((rho.act gamma⁻¹).hom ≫ q) := Category.assoc _ _ _
91	    _ = h ≫ q := congrArg (fun m => h ≫ m) (hqinv gamma⁻¹)

93	variable {g : Y ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)}
94	
95	omit [FiniteDimensional K L] [IsGalois K L] in
96	/-- A kernel-pair equality descends an equivariant field-valued morphism and
97	gives its unique factorization through the proposed quotient. -/
98	theorem galoisQuotientUniversal_of_kernelPair
99	    (e : pullback g (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K L))) ≅ X)
100	    (hover : e.hom ≫ f =
101	      pullback.snd g (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K L))))
102	    (hprojection : e.inv ≫
103	      pullback.fst g (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K L))) = q)
104	    (hkernel : ∀ (T : Scheme.{u}) (t : T ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of K))
105	      (h : pullback t (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K L))) ⟶ X),
106	      h ≫ f = pullback.snd t
107	        (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K L))) →
108	      (pullbackSemilinearGalAction K L t).IsEquivariant rho h →
109	      pullback.fst
110	          (pullback.fst t (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K L))))
111	          (pullback.fst t (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K L)))) ≫
112	          h ≫ q =
113	        pullback.snd
114	          (pullback.fst t (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K L))))
115	          (pullback.fst t (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K L)))) ≫
116	          h ≫ q) :
117	    ∀ (T : Scheme.{u}) (t : T ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of K))
118	      (h : pullback t (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K L))) ⟶ X),
119	      h ≫ f = pullback.snd t
120	        (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K L))) →
121	      (pullbackSemilinearGalAction K L t).IsEquivariant rho h →
122	      ∃! v : {v : T ⟶ Y // v ≫ g = t},
123	        pullbackBaseChange K L g t v.1 v.2 ≫ e.hom = h := by
124	  intro T t h hoverh hequivh
125	  let base : Spec (CommRingCat.of L) ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of K) :=
126	    Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K L))
127	  let TL : Scheme.{u} := pullback t base
128	  let p : TL ⟶ T := pullback.fst t base
129	  let r : TL ⟶ Y := h ≫ q
130	  have hkernel' : pullback.fst p p ≫ r = pullback.snd p p ≫ r := by
131	    exact hkernel T t h hoverh hequivh
132	  have hdesc : ∀ {Z : Scheme.{u}} (a b : Z ⟶ TL),
133	      a ≫ p = b ≫ p → a ≫ r = b ≫ r := by
134	    intro Z a b hab
135	    let z : Z ⟶ pullback p p := pullback.lift a b hab
136	    calc
137	      a ≫ r = (z ≫ pullback.fst p p) ≫ r := by rw [pullback.lift_fst]
138	      _ = z ≫ (pullback.fst p p ≫ r) := Category.assoc _ _ _

8	/-!
9	# Finite separable field extensions are étale covers, and the descent test they give
10	
11	This file supplies the **cover** that the repaired campaign tail `G1`/`G3` needs:
12	`Spec k' ⟶ Spec k` for a finite separable extension `k'/k` is a *singleton étale
13	covering* of `Spec k`, its base change along any `k`-scheme `T` is again one, and
14	the resulting sieve lies in `etaleTopologyOver k` — the site on which
15	`PicScheme.picEt` is a sheaf.
16	
17	## Why this file exists
18	
19	The seam's single open obligation `Scheme.fgaPicardRepresentability`
20	(`Picard/FGAPicRepresentability.lean`) is routed through the Milne–Kollár
21	campaign (`informal/pic-representability-campaign.md`). That campaign builds a
22	representing scheme over a separably closed field (`J1`–`J5`), spreads it to a
23	finite Galois level (`G1`) and descends to `k` (`G3`). Its tail is stated for
24	`picSharp`, and that is where the route is believed to break:
25	`PicScheme.not_exists_representing_picSharp_of_not_isIso`
26	(`Picard/PicEtSubcanonical.lean`) proves that **no** scheme represents
27	`picSharp C` once `picEtComparison C` fails to be an isomorphism.
28	
29	**That is a conditional theorem, and the antecedent is not formalised** — stated
30	plainly because this file's own earlier revision asserted the conclusion flatly.
31	`¬IsIso (picEtComparison C)` is an explicit hypothesis of that theorem, proved for
32	no curve. Kleiman's real conic `u²+v²+w²=0` in `ℙ²_ℝ` meets the *binders*
33	(smooth, proper, geometrically integral, no rational point) and he states the
34	non-representability, but the Lean antecedent — that the comparison genuinely
35	fails there, via `φ*O(1)` and `h⁰` on `ℙ¹_ℂ` — is quoted rather than proved
36	(`PicEtSubcanonical.lean` §4 says so of itself). So the honest form is: *if* the
37	comparison fails for one such curve, `G3`/`G4` target a false statement; and the
38	repair is then to descend `picEt`, which **is** an étale sheaf
39	(`PicScheme.picEt_isSheaf_forget`) — whereas whether `picSharp` fails étale
40	descent is likewise not proved here (`th:cmp` part 1 shows it is at least
41	Zariski-*separated* on these binders).
42	
43	Under that repair the descent step needs `Spec k' ⟶ Spec k` to be an **étale
44	covering** in Mathlib's sense, and nothing in the tree provided that. §1–§3 prove
45	it. §4 records what the sheaf side contributes, which is less than an earlier
46	revision claimed. It is infrastructure, not a discharge:
47	
48	**No `sorry` is closed here, and no antecedent of the seam is witnessed.** What
49	changes is that the cover the restated `G3` quantifies over is now a theorem
50	rather than a hypothesis.
51	
52	## The measurement that motivated the shape of the proofs
53	
54	`Algebra.Etale k k'` does **not** synthesize from
55	`[Algebra.IsSeparable k k'] [Module.Finite k k']`, and neither does
56	`Etale (Spec.map …)`; a lane reading a failing `infer_instance` as an absence
57	would conclude this cover is unavailable. Both are assembled below from theorem
58	forms (`Algebra.FormallyEtale.of_isSeparable`,
59	`Algebra.FinitePresentation.of_finiteType`, `RingHom.etale_algebraMap`,
60	`HasRingHomProperty.Spec_iff`). The *base change* of the cover, by contrast, is
61	free by synthesis — `Etale` and `Surjective` are both stable under base change in
62	Mathlib.
63	
64	The sibling project `Algebraic-Jacobian-Challenge-Rebuild` has a
65	character-identical `Algebra.Etale` instance — the *anonymous*
66	`instance : Algebra.Etale K L` at `AlgebraicJacobian/Algebra/EtaleCover.lean:304`,
67	not the `def` `Algebra.EtaleCover.ofField` below it. The duplication is
68	unavoidable rather than an oversight: AJC's `lakefile.toml` requires only
69	`checkdecls`, `doc-gen4` and `mathlib`, no AJCR file is in AJC's import closure,
70	and there is no dependency edge to add one. The scheme-level covering statements
71	below are in neither project.
72	
73	Both hypotheses are load-bearing, measured by dropping each: without
74	`[Algebra.IsSeparable k k']`, and separately without `[Module.Finite k k']`,
75	`etale_specMap_algebraMap` fails with
76	`failed to synthesize instance of type class Algebra.Etale …`.
77	
78	## Main results
79	
80	* `Scheme.etale_specMap_algebraMap` — `Spec k' ⟶ Spec k` is étale.
81	* `Scheme.surjective_specMap_algebraMap` — and surjective (both spectra are
82	  one-point), so no separability or finiteness is used.
83	* `Scheme.singleton_mem_etalePrecoverage_specMap` — the singleton family is an
84	  étale cover of `Spec k`.
85	* `Scheme.etale_pullback_fst_specMap` / `Scheme.surjective_pullback_fst_specMap`
86	  — its base change along an arbitrary `k`-scheme is again étale and surjective.
87	* `Scheme.sieve_specMap_mem_etaleTopology` — the generated sieve is a covering
88	  sieve of `Scheme.etaleTopology`.
89	* `Scheme.isSheafFor_picEt_of_mem` — the sheaf axiom of `picEt C` at an
90	  **arbitrary** covering sieve, `PicScheme.picEt_isSheaf_forget` unfolded. Free
91	  from sheafification; recorded to make clear that §4 is not where the work is.
92	* `Scheme.isSheafFor_picEt_pullback_presieve` — the same at the field-extension
93	  cover. Its content over the previous item is the membership witness, i.e. §1–§3.
94	* `Scheme.picEt_ext_of_pullback_agrees` — the uniqueness half alone: restriction
95	  along the cover is injective on `picEt`-classes.
96	
97	Nothing in the tree consumes these yet; the consumer is the restated `G3`.
98	
99	## References
100	
101	Kleiman, "The Picard scheme" (arXiv:math/0504020), §4 Thm `th:main`.
102	Campaign milestones `G1`, `G3`. Board: `AJC.picrep.etale-rep`. Decision:
103	`I-0491`.
104	-/

121	/-- **A finite separable field extension is an étale algebra.**
122	
123	Formal étaleness is separability (`Algebra.FormallyEtale.of_isSeparable`), and
124	finite presentation follows from finite type over a field

128	`Algebra.Etale k k'` does *not* synthesize without it: this is the declaration

130	instance etale_of_finite_isSeparable : Algebra.Etale k k' where
131	  formallyEtale := Algebra.FormallyEtale.of_isSeparable k k'
132	  finitePresentation :=
133	    (Algebra.FinitePresentation.of_finiteType (R := k) (A := k')).mp inferInstance

144	fields: both spectra have exactly one point, so this needs neither separability

151	    Function.Surjective (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k k'))).base :=
152	  fun _ => ⟨default, Subsingleton.elim _ _⟩

155	theorem surjective_specMap_algebraMap :
156	    Surjective (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k k'))) :=

universe u

open CategoryTheory AlgebraicGeometry Limits

namespace AlgebraicGeometry

namespace Scheme

namespace PicScheme

variable {k : Type u} [Field k] {k' : Type u} [Field k'] [Algebra k k']

/-! ## §1. The cover of a `k`-test by its base change, as an `Over`-morphism -/

/-- The base change `T ×_k Spec k'` of a `k`-test `T`, regarded as a `k'`-test
via the second projection.

This is the object the descent step's classes live on: a class over `k'` is a
class on `T_{k'}` for the tests `T` of interest, and `§2` shows a `k`-class is
determined by its restriction here. -/
noncomputable abbrev baseTest (T : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))) :
    Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k')) :=
  Over.mk (pullback.snd T.hom (specMapAlgebra k k'))

/-- **The covering morphism `T_{k'} ⟶ T`**, in the slice over `Spec k`.

Its underlying scheme map is exactly `pullback.fst`, which is the morphism
`Picard/EtaleFieldCover.lean` builds its covering sieve from — so the sheaf
axiom landed there applies to this morphism on the nose (checked by `rfl`:
`coverMap_left`). -/
noncomputable def coverMap (T : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))) :
    (restrictTest k k').obj (baseTest (k' := k') T) ⟶ T :=
  Over.homMk (pullback.fst T.hom (specMapAlgebra k k'))
    (pullback.condition (f := T.hom) (g := specMapAlgebra k k'))

/-- The cover morphism's underlying scheme map **is** `pullback.fst`, definitionally.

This is the identification that lets `§2` feed
`Scheme.picEt_ext_of_pullback_agrees`, whose sieve is generated by
`Presieve.singleton (pullback.fst T.hom (specMapAlgebra k k'))`. -/
@[simp]
theorem coverMap_left (T : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))) :
    (coverMap (k' := k') T).left = pullback.fst T.hom (specMapAlgebra k k') := rfl

/-! ## §2. The uniqueness half of the descent — PROVED -/

/-- **Restriction along `T_{k'} ⟶ T` is injective on `picEt`-classes.**

For a smooth proper curve `C` over an arbitrary field `k`, an arbitrary finite
separable `k'/k`, and an arbitrary `k`-test `T`: two classes in
`Pic_{(C/k)ét}(T)` that agree after restriction to `T ×_k Spec k'` are equal.

This is the *uniqueness* half of the descent step, and it is what makes a
descended class unique once one exists — so a consumer holding a single class,
rather than a compatible family, needs no separate uniqueness hypothesis.

**Where the content is, stated precisely.** The amalgamation property itself is
free: `Scheme.isSheafFor_picEt_of_mem` holds at *every* covering sieve of
`etaleTopologyOver k`, `⊤` included, because it is `PicSharp.etaleSheaf`'s own
`Sheaf.cond` pushed through the forgetful functor. What this lemma adds over
`Scheme.picEt_ext_of_pullback_agrees` is the reduction from that lemma's
*sieve-indexed* hypothesis — agreement after restriction along **every** arrow of
the generated sieve — to agreement along the **single** morphism `coverMap`. The
step is the factorisation: an arrow of the sieve factors through `pullback.fst`,
and lifting that factorisation to the slice over `Spec k` is where
`pullback.condition` is consumed.

**That the factorisation is not avoidable is measured, not assumed** — it is the
obvious refutation of this lemma ("the sheaf axiom gives injectivity directly, so
the hand proof is redundant"), so it was probed rather than argued. Two routes,
both `EXIT=1`:

* deriving it from the amalgamation statement
  (`Scheme.isSheafFor_picEt_pullback_presieve`) requires exhibiting a
  `Presieve.FamilyOfElements` on the *whole* sieve for which both classes are
  amalgamations, and constructing that family needs a value at every sieve arrow —
  i.e. the same factorisation, relocated;
* discharging the sieve-indexed goal from the single-morphism hypothesis with no
  factorisation work fails: `exact h`, `simpa using h`, `congrArg _ h` and `aesop`
  all leave the goal open (`aesop` reports exhaustive search).

So the content is the reduction, and only the reduction. Whoever re-checks this
should re-run those two probes rather than trust the paragraph.

**No hypothesis on `C(k)`** (`I-0491`), and none on `T`. The finite-separability
binders are inherited from the covering-sieve membership witness of
`Picard/EtaleFieldCover.lean`, which is where they are genuinely used; they are
*not* needed by the cross-base identification (`picEt_crossBaseIso` holds for an
arbitrary field extension). -/
theorem picEt_injective_restrict_baseTest
    [FiniteDimensional k k'] [Algebra.IsSeparable k k']
    (C : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)))
    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
    (T : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)))
    {t₁ t₂ : (picEt C).obj (Opposite.op T)}
    (h : (picEt C).map (coverMap (k' := k') T).op t₁
       = (picEt C).map (coverMap (k' := k') T).op t₂) :
    t₁ = t₂ := by
  refine AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.picEt_ext_of_pullback_agrees k' C T ?_
  intro W g hg
  rw [Sieve.overEquiv_symm_iff] at hg
  obtain ⟨Z, a, b, hb, hfac⟩ := hg
  cases hb
  -- `g` factors through `coverMap` in the slice over `Spec k`.
  have hgfac : g = (Over.homMk a (by
      rw [← Over.w g]
      simp only [restrictTest, Over.map_obj_hom, baseTest, Over.mk_hom, ← hfac]
      rw [Category.assoc]
      exact congrArg (a ≫ ·) pullback.condition.symm) :
        W ⟶ (restrictTest k k').obj (baseTest (k' := k') T))
      ≫ coverMap (k' := k') T := by
    apply Over.OverMorphism.ext
    change Over.Hom.left g = a ≫ pullback.fst T.hom (specMapAlgebra k k')
    exact hfac.symm
  rw [hgfac]
  simp only [op_comp, Functor.map_comp, CategoryTheory.comp_apply, h]

/-! ## §3. The input-side transport, and the sharp form of what remains -/

/-- **The `k'`-side input, transported: PROVED, and free.**

A representation of `picEt` of the **base-changed curve** `C_{k'}` by a
`k'`-scheme `X'` is the same thing as a representation of `picEt C` restricted to
`k'`-tests. This is `picEt_crossBaseIso` (input 2 of the repair, closed
unconditionally by `Picard/PicEtCrossBase.lean`) fed to
`Functor.RepresentableBy.ofIso`.

It is recorded because it is the step that makes the assembly's hypothesis
*statable in the right variables*: without it the `k'`-scheme that campaign `J5`
produces would represent `picEt` of the `k`-curve restricted to `k'`-tests rather
than `picEt` of `C_{k'}`, and there would be no functor for the Galois action to
act on — a mismatch no green build reveals.

No separability or finiteness hypothesis on `k'/k`: the cross-base identification
never needed one. -/
noncomputable def representableByRestrict_of_baseChange
    (C : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)))
    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
    {X' : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k'))}
    (rep : (picEt (Scheme.baseChangeField C k')).RepresentableBy X') :
=====BRIDGE
variable {k : Type u} [Field k] {k' : Type u} [Field k'] [Algebra k k']

/-! ## §1. The `γ`-twist of a base-changed test -/

/-- `Spec γ : Spec k' ⟶ Spec k'`, the scheme map of a `k`-automorphism of `k'`. -/
noncomputable abbrev specGal (γ : k' ≃ₐ[k] k') :
    Spec (CommRingCat.of k') ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of k') :=
  Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (γ : k' →+* k'))

/-- **`Spec γ` is a morphism over `Spec k`.**

This is `γ.commutes` — that `γ` fixes `k` — transported through `Spec`. It is the
only place the `k`-algebra structure of `γ` (as opposed to its being a ring
automorphism) is consumed, and everything else in this file is formal. -/
theorem specGal_comp (γ : k' ≃ₐ[k] k') :
    specGal γ ≫ specMapAlgebra k k' = specMapAlgebra k k' := by
  rw [specMapAlgebra, ← Spec.map_comp]
  congr 1
  ext x
  exact γ.commutes x

/-- The `γ`-twist of `T ×_k Spec k'` on underlying schemes: the identity on the `T`
factor and `Spec γ` on the `Spec k'` factor.

Well defined because `Spec γ` is a morphism over `Spec k` (`specGal_comp`), so the
twisted pair still satisfies the pullback condition. -/
noncomputable def twistLeft (T : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))) (γ : k' ≃ₐ[k] k') :
    pullback T.hom (specMapAlgebra k k') ⟶ pullback T.hom (specMapAlgebra k k') :=
  pullback.lift (pullback.fst _ _) (pullback.snd _ _ ≫ specGal γ) (by
    rw [Category.assoc, specGal_comp]
    exact pullback.condition)

/-- **The `γ`-twist as an endomorphism of the base-changed test, in the slice over
`Spec k`.**

This is the morphism a `γ`-invariance hypothesis is a statement about. **The
scheme-level twist already existed and an earlier revision of this docstring denied
it** (`I-1455`): `twistLeft` is `rfl`-equal to
`AlgebraicJacobian.GaloisDescent.pullbackGalMap k k' T.hom γ⁻¹`
(`Picard/FiniteGaloisQuotient.lean`, which also has the two projection identities
and the whole semilinear action). The denial was a census scoped to
`Picard/GaloisDescent/` reported as a fact about the project — literally true of the
directory, false of the tree, and exactly the trap that makes a lane rebuild a
landed construction. What this file adds is the **slice-over-`Spec k`** packaging,
which is what `picEt` consumes.

It is a slice morphism over `Spec k`, not over `Spec k'`: the twist moves the
`k'`-structure and is *not* `k'`-linear, which is exactly the semilinearity of the
Galois action, and is why the descent runs in the `k`-slice. -/
noncomputable def twistTest (T : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))) (γ : k' ≃ₐ[k] k') :
    (restrictTest k k').obj (baseTest (k' := k') T) ⟶
      (restrictTest k k').obj (baseTest (k' := k') T) :=
  Over.homMk (twistLeft T γ) (by
    change twistLeft T γ ≫ pullback.snd _ _ ≫ specMapAlgebra k k' = _
    rw [twistLeft, pullback.lift_snd_assoc, Category.assoc, specGal_comp]
    rfl)

/-- **The twist lives over `T`**: it commutes with the covering morphism.

This is what makes the twist a morphism of *descent data* rather than merely of
schemes, and it is `pullback.lift_fst` — the twist is the identity on the `T`
factor. -/
theorem twistTest_comp_coverMap (T : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))) (γ : k' ≃ₐ[k] k') :
    twistTest T γ ≫ coverMap (k' := k') T = coverMap (k' := k') T := by
  apply Over.OverMorphism.ext
  change twistLeft T γ ≫ pullback.fst _ _ = pullback.fst _ _
  exact pullback.lift_fst _ _ _

/-! ## §2. The `γ`-component section of the cover's self-pullback -/

/-- **THE COHERENCE, as a morphism**: the `γ`-component
`T_{k'} ⟶ T_{k'} ×_T T_{k'}`, namely `⟨𝟙, twist γ⟩`.

`PicEtDescentExistence.lean` §4 named the open link as "the `Gal`-coproduct's
`γ`-component inclusion composed with the two projections gives `id` and `γ`", with
the ingredients listed as `pullbackSpecIso`, `IsIso (sigmaSpec …)` and
`galoisSelfTensorEquiv`. **None of those three is needed for the coherence itself.**
The section exists by the universal property of the pullback, from
`twistTest_comp_coverMap` alone, and the two identities below are
`pullback.lift_fst` and `pullback.lift_snd`. The splitting is needed for something
else — see §4.

No hypothesis on `k'/k` beyond `[Algebra k k']`. -/
noncomputable def coverSelfSection (T : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))) (γ : k' ≃ₐ[k] k') :
    (restrictTest k k').obj (baseTest (k' := k') T) ⟶
      pullback (coverMap (k := k) (k' := k') T) (coverMap (k := k) (k' := k') T) :=
  pullback.lift (𝟙 _) (twistTest T γ) (by
    rw [Category.id_comp, twistTest_comp_coverMap])

/-- The `γ`-component composed with the **first** projection is the identity. -/
@[simp] theorem coverSelfSection_fst (T : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))) (γ : k' ≃ₐ[k] k') :
    coverSelfSection T γ ≫ pullback.fst (coverMap (k := k) (k' := k') T)
      (coverMap (k := k) (k' := k') T) = 𝟙 _ :=
  pullback.lift_fst _ _ _

/-- The `γ`-component composed with the **second** projection is the `γ`-twist. -/
@[simp] theorem coverSelfSection_snd (T : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))) (γ : k' ≃ₐ[k] k') :
    coverSelfSection T γ ≫ pullback.snd (coverMap (k := k) (k' := k') T)
      (coverMap (k := k) (k' := k') T) = twistTest T γ :=
  pullback.lift_snd _ _ _

/-! ## §3. Agreement ⟹ invariance — free, and at full generality -/

/-- **The direction that is free: projection agreement gives `γ`-invariance, for
every `γ`.**

If a class `x` on `T_{k'}` has equal pullbacks along the two projections of
`T_{k'} ×_T T_{k'}`, then `x` is fixed by the `γ`-twist for every
`γ ∈ Gal(k'/k)` — hence `ajc-p2`'s hypothesis is *at least as strong as*
`γ`-invariance.

97	    (specRingEquivIso ψ).hom = Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (ψ.symm : T →+* S)) := rfl

105	/-! ## Composition calculus for `pullbackBaseChange` -/
106	
107	section BaseChangeCalculus
108	
109	/-- Base change is functorial: the base change of a composite of morphisms over
110	`Spec K` is the composite of the base changes. -/
111	@[reassoc]
112	lemma pullbackBaseChange_comp {T' T Y : Scheme.{u}}
113	    (g : Y ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) (t : T ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of K))
114	    (t' : T' ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) (u : T ⟶ Y) (hu : u ≫ g = t)
115	    (v : T' ⟶ T) (hv : v ≫ t = t') :
116	    pullbackBaseChange K L g t' (v ≫ u) (by rw [Category.assoc, hu, hv])
117	      = pullbackBaseChange K L t t' v hv ≫ pullbackBaseChange K L g t u hu := by
118	  apply pullback.hom_ext <;> simp
119	
120	/-- `pullbackBaseChange` only depends on the underlying morphism. -/
121	lemma pullbackBaseChange_congr {T Y : Scheme.{u}}
122	    (g : Y ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) (t : T ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of K))
123	    {u u' : T ⟶ Y} (huu' : u = u') (hu : u ≫ g = t) :
124	    pullbackBaseChange K L g t u hu = pullbackBaseChange K L g t u' (huu' ▸ hu) := by
125	  subst huu'; rfl
126	
127	end BaseChangeCalculus
128	
129	/-- `Spec` of a `K`-algebra map is a morphism over `Spec K`. -/
130	lemma specMap_algHom_comp {C D : Type u} [CommRing C] [CommRing D] [Algebra K C]
131	    [Algebra K D] (φ : C →ₐ[K] D) :
132	    Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ.toRingHom)
133	        ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K C))
134	      = Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K D)) := by
135	  rw [← Spec.map_comp, ← CommRingCat.ofHom_comp]
136	  congr 2
137	  exact φ.comp_algebraMap

139	/-! ## The base change of an affine scheme, in engine order `L ⊗[K] ·` -/
140	
141	section PullbackSpecLIso
142	
143	variable (C : Type u) [CommRing C] [Algebra K C]
144	
145	/-- For affine `T = Spec C` over `Spec K`, the base change `T ×_{Spec K} Spec L` is
146	`Spec (L ⊗[K] C)`, with the tensor factors in the engine order (the Galois-acted
147	factor `L` on the **left**): mathlib's `pullbackSpecIso` composed with the factor
148	swap `Algebra.TensorProduct.comm`. -/
149	noncomputable def pullbackSpecLIso :
150	    pullback (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K C)))
151	        (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K L)))
152	      ≅ Spec (CommRingCat.of (L ⊗[K] C)) :=
153	  pullbackSpecIso K C L ≪≫
154	    specRingEquivIso (Algebra.TensorProduct.comm K C L).toRingEquiv
155	
156	@[reassoc (attr := simp)]
157	lemma pullbackSpecLIso_inv_fst :
158	    (pullbackSpecLIso K L C).inv ≫ pullback.fst _ _
159	      = Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
160	          (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight : C →ₐ[K] L ⊗[K] C).toRingHom) := by
161	  simp only [pullbackSpecLIso, Iso.trans_inv, specRingEquivIso_inv]
162	  rw [Category.assoc, pullbackSpecIso_inv_fst, ← Spec.map_comp, ← CommRingCat.ofHom_comp]
163	  congr 2
164	
165	@[reassoc (attr := simp)]
166	lemma pullbackSpecLIso_inv_snd :
167	    (pullbackSpecLIso K L C).inv ≫ pullback.snd _ _
168	      = Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap L (L ⊗[K] C))) := by
169	  simp only [pullbackSpecLIso, Iso.trans_inv, specRingEquivIso_inv]
170	  rw [Category.assoc, pullbackSpecIso_inv_snd, ← Spec.map_comp, ← CommRingCat.ofHom_comp]
171	  congr 2
172	
173	/-- Equivariance of `pullbackSpecLIso`, inverse form: the `toSpecAut` action of `γ`
174	on `Spec (L ⊗[K] C)` (left-factor Galois action) corresponds to the canonical
175	base-change action `pullbackGalMap` on `Spec C ×_{Spec K} Spec L`. -/
176	lemma toSpecAut_hom_pullbackSpecLIso_inv (γ : L ≃ₐ[K] L) :
177	    (toSpecAut (L ≃ₐ[K] L) (L ⊗[K] C) γ).hom ≫ (pullbackSpecLIso K L C).inv
178	      = (pullbackSpecLIso K L C).inv
179	          ≫ pullbackGalMap K L (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K C))) γ := by
180	  apply pullback.hom_ext
181	  · rw [Category.assoc, Category.assoc, pullbackGalMap_fst, pullbackSpecLIso_inv_fst,
182	      toSpecAut_hom, ← Spec.map_comp, ← CommRingCat.ofHom_comp]
183	    congr 2
184	    ext c
185	    change γ⁻¹ • ((1 : L) ⊗ₜ[K] c) = (1 : L) ⊗ₜ[K] c
186	    rw [galTensor_smul_def]
187	    simp
188	  · rw [Category.assoc, Category.assoc, pullbackGalMap_snd,
189	      pullbackSpecLIso_inv_snd_assoc, pullbackSpecLIso_inv_snd, toSpecAut_hom,
190	      toSpecAut_hom, ← Spec.map_comp, ← Spec.map_comp, ← CommRingCat.ofHom_comp,
191	      ← CommRingCat.ofHom_comp]
192	    congr 2
193	
194	/-- Equivariance of `pullbackSpecLIso`, hom form. -/
195	lemma pullbackGalMap_pullbackSpecLIso_hom (γ : L ≃ₐ[K] L) :
196	    pullbackGalMap K L (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K C))) γ
197	        ≫ (pullbackSpecLIso K L C).hom
198	      = (pullbackSpecLIso K L C).hom ≫ (toSpecAut (L ≃ₐ[K] L) (L ⊗[K] C) γ).hom := by
199	  rw [← cancel_epi (pullbackSpecLIso K L C).inv, ← Category.assoc,
200	    ← toSpecAut_hom_pullbackSpecLIso_inv, Category.assoc, Iso.inv_hom_id,
201	    Category.comp_id, Iso.inv_hom_id_assoc]
202	
203	/-- Naturality of `pullbackSpecLIso` in the affine base: the base change of `Spec`
204	of a `K`-algebra map `φ : C →ₐ[K] D` corresponds to `Spec (id_L ⊗ φ)`. -/
205	lemma pullbackSpecLIso_inv_pullbackBaseChange {D : Type u} [CommRing D] [Algebra K D]
206	    (φ : C →ₐ[K] D) :
207	    (pullbackSpecLIso K L D).inv
208	        ≫ pullbackBaseChange K L (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K C)))
209	            (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K D)))
210	            (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ.toRingHom)) (specMap_algHom_comp K φ)
211	      = Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
212	            (Algebra.TensorProduct.map (AlgHom.id L L) φ).toRingHom)
213	        ≫ (pullbackSpecLIso K L C).inv := by
214	  apply pullback.hom_ext
215	  · rw [Category.assoc, Category.assoc, pullbackBaseChange_fst,
216	      pullbackSpecLIso_inv_fst_assoc, pullbackSpecLIso_inv_fst, ← Spec.map_comp,
217	      ← Spec.map_comp, ← CommRingCat.ofHom_comp, ← CommRingCat.ofHom_comp]
218	    congr 2
219	  · rw [Category.assoc, Category.assoc, pullbackBaseChange_snd,
220	      pullbackSpecLIso_inv_snd, pullbackSpecLIso_inv_snd, ← Spec.map_comp,
221	      ← CommRingCat.ofHom_comp]
222	    congr 2
223	    ext a
224	    change algebraMap L (L ⊗[K] D) a
225	      = Algebra.TensorProduct.map (AlgHom.id L L) φ (algebraMap L (L ⊗[K] C) a)
226	    change a ⊗ₜ[K] (1 : D) = Algebra.TensorProduct.map (AlgHom.id L L) φ (a ⊗ₜ[K] (1 : C))
227	    simp
228	
229	end PullbackSpecLIso
