231	/-! ## The equivariant base-change isomorphism `Spec A^Γ ×_{Spec K} Spec L ≅ Spec A` -/
232	
233	section AffineGaloisQuotient
234	
235	variable (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [Algebra K A] [Algebra L A] [IsScalarTower K L A]
236	variable [MulSemiringAction (L ≃ₐ[K] L) A] [IsSemilinear K L A]
237	variable [FiniteDimensional K L] [IsGalois K L]
238	
239	omit [Algebra K A] [IsScalarTower K L A] [FiniteDimensional K L] [IsGalois K L] in
240	@[simp] lemma specSemilinearGalAction_act (γ : L ≃ₐ[K] L) :
241	    (specSemilinearGalAction K L A).act γ = toSpecAut (L ≃ₐ[K] L) A γ := rfl
242	
243	/-- **The `Γ`-equivariant base-change isomorphism** (Speiser descent, `Spec` form):
244	`Spec (A^Γ) ×_{Spec K} Spec L ≅ Spec A`, the composite of `pullbackSpecLIso` with
245	`Spec` of the descent isomorphism `L ⊗[K] A^Γ ≃ₐ[L] A`. -/
246	noncomputable def affineQuotientPullbackIso :
247	    pullback (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K (invariantsSubalgebra K L A))))
248	        (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K L)))
249	      ≅ Spec (CommRingCat.of A) :=
250	  pullbackSpecLIso K L (invariantsSubalgebra K L A) ≪≫
251	    specRingEquivIso (descentAlgEquiv K L A).toRingEquiv
252	
253	/-- The descent isomorphism is a morphism over `Spec L` (inverse form). -/
254	@[reassoc (attr := simp)]
255	theorem affineQuotientPullbackIso_inv_snd :
256	    (affineQuotientPullbackIso K L A).inv ≫ pullback.snd _ _
257	      = Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap L A)) := by
258	  simp only [affineQuotientPullbackIso, Iso.trans_inv, specRingEquivIso_inv]
259	  rw [Category.assoc, pullbackSpecLIso_inv_snd, ← Spec.map_comp,
260	    ← CommRingCat.ofHom_comp]
261	  congr 2
262	  ext a
263	  exact (descentAlgEquiv K L A).commutes a
264	
265	/-- The quotient projection underlying the named base-change isomorphism is the
266	canonical map induced by the inclusion of the invariant subalgebra.  This is the
267	projection identity used to restrict the quotient to stable open subsets. -/
268	@[reassoc]
269	theorem affineQuotientPullbackIso_inv_fst :
270	    (affineQuotientPullbackIso K L A).inv ≫ pullback.fst _ _ =
271	      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
272	        (SemilinearAction.invariantsSubalgebra K L A).val) := by
273	  simp only [affineQuotientPullbackIso, Iso.trans_inv, specRingEquivIso_inv]
274	  rw [Category.assoc, pullbackSpecLIso_inv_fst, ← Spec.map_comp,
275	    ← CommRingCat.ofHom_comp]
276	  congr 2
277	  ext w
278	  change SemilinearAction.descentAlgEquiv K L A (1 ⊗ₜ[K] w) = (w : A)
279	  rw [SemilinearAction.descentAlgEquiv_tmul, one_smul]
280	
281	/-- The descent isomorphism is a morphism over `Spec L` (clause 1 of
282	`IsGaloisQuotient`). -/
283	@[reassoc (attr := simp)]
284	theorem affineQuotientPullbackIso_hom_specMap :
285	    (affineQuotientPullbackIso K L A).hom
286	        ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap L A))
287	      = pullback.snd _ _ := by
288	  rw [← affineQuotientPullbackIso_inv_snd K L A, Iso.hom_inv_id_assoc]
289	
290	/-- The descent isomorphism is `Γ`-equivariant (clause 2 of `IsGaloisQuotient`). -/
291	theorem isEquivariant_affineQuotientPullbackIso_hom :
292	    (pullbackSemilinearGalAction K L
293	        (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
294	          (algebraMap K (invariantsSubalgebra K L A))))).IsEquivariant
295	      (specSemilinearGalAction K L A) (affineQuotientPullbackIso K L A).hom := by
296	  intro γ
297	  rw [pullbackSemilinearGalAction_act_hom, specSemilinearGalAction_act]
298	  simp only [affineQuotientPullbackIso, Iso.trans_hom]
299	  rw [← Category.assoc, pullbackGalMap_pullbackSpecLIso_hom, Category.assoc,
300	    Category.assoc]
301	  congr 1
302	  rw [toSpecAut_hom, toSpecAut_hom, specRingEquivIso_hom, ← Spec.map_comp,
303	    ← Spec.map_comp, ← CommRingCat.ofHom_comp, ← CommRingCat.ofHom_comp]
304	  congr 2
305	  ext x
306	  change γ⁻¹ • ((descentAlgEquiv K L A).symm x) = (descentAlgEquiv K L A).symm (γ⁻¹ • x)
307	  apply (descentAlgEquiv K L A).injective
308	  rw [galTensor_smul_def, descentAlgEquiv_map_left, AlgEquiv.apply_symm_apply,
309	    AlgEquiv.apply_symm_apply]

311	/-! ## The `T`-points property, affine case -/
312	
313	variable (B : Type u) [CommRing B] [Algebra K B]
314	
315	/-- The base change of `Spec` of a `K`-algebra map `φ : A^Γ →ₐ[K] B`, composed with
316	the descent isomorphism, is `Spec` of `extendScalarsAlgHom φ : A →ₐ[L] L ⊗[K] B`
317	read through `pullbackSpecLIso`.  Scheme-level form of the forward direction of
318	`invariantAlgHomEquiv`. -/
319	theorem pullbackBaseChange_specMap_algHom_comp_hom
320	    (φ : invariantsSubalgebra K L A →ₐ[K] B) :
321	    pullbackBaseChange K L
322	        (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K (invariantsSubalgebra K L A))))
323	        (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K B)))
324	        (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ.toRingHom)) (specMap_algHom_comp K φ)
325	      ≫ (affineQuotientPullbackIso K L A).hom
326	      = (pullbackSpecLIso K L B).hom
327	          ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (extendScalarsAlgHom K L A B φ).toRingHom) := by
328	  rw [← Iso.inv_comp_eq]
329	  simp only [affineQuotientPullbackIso, Iso.trans_hom]
330	  rw [← Category.assoc, pullbackSpecLIso_inv_pullbackBaseChange K L _ φ,
331	    Category.assoc, Iso.inv_hom_id_assoc, specRingEquivIso_hom, ← Spec.map_comp,
332	    ← CommRingCat.ofHom_comp]
333	  congr 2
334	
335	/-- The value of `affineGaloisQuotientHomEquiv` is `Spec` of `extendScalarsAlgHom` of
336	the corresponding algebra map (definitional unfolding). -/
337	lemma affineGaloisQuotientHomEquiv_apply_coe
338	    (u : {u : Spec (CommRingCat.of B) ⟶
339	        Spec (CommRingCat.of (invariantsSubalgebra K L A)) //
340	      u ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K (invariantsSubalgebra K L A)))
341	        = Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K B))}) :
342	    (affineGaloisQuotientHomEquiv K L A B u).1
343	      = Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (extendScalarsAlgHom K L A B
344	          (specOverEquivAlgHom K (invariantsSubalgebra K L A) B u)).toRingHom) := rfl
345	
346	/-- The base change of any morphism `Spec B ⟶ Spec A^Γ` over `Spec K`, composed with
347	the descent isomorphism, computes as the corresponding equivariant morphism
348	`Spec (L ⊗[K] B) ⟶ Spec A` of `affineGaloisQuotientHomEquiv`, read through
349	`pullbackSpecLIso`. -/
350	theorem pullbackBaseChange_comp_affineQuotientPullbackIso_hom
351	    (u : {u : Spec (CommRingCat.of B) ⟶
352	        Spec (CommRingCat.of (invariantsSubalgebra K L A)) //
353	      u ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K (invariantsSubalgebra K L A)))
354	        = Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K B))}) :
355	    pullbackBaseChange K L
356	        (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K (invariantsSubalgebra K L A))))
357	        (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K B))) u.1 u.2
358	      ≫ (affineQuotientPullbackIso K L A).hom
359	      = (pullbackSpecLIso K L B).hom ≫ (affineGaloisQuotientHomEquiv K L A B u).1 := by
360	  have hu1 : u.1 = Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
361	      (specOverEquivAlgHom K (invariantsSubalgebra K L A) B u).toRingHom) :=
362	    congrArg Subtype.val
363	      ((specOverEquivAlgHom K (invariantsSubalgebra K L A) B).symm_apply_apply u).symm
364	  rw [pullbackBaseChange_congr K L _ _ hu1,
365	    pullbackBaseChange_specMap_algHom_comp_hom, affineGaloisQuotientHomEquiv_apply_coe]
366	
367	/-- **The `T`-points property of the affine Galois quotient, affine `T`** (campaign
368	`G2(b)`, `∃!` form): for affine `T = Spec B` over `Spec K`, every `Γ`-equivariant
369	morphism `T ×_{Spec K} Spec L ⟶ Spec A` over `Spec L` descends uniquely through the
370	descent isomorphism to `T ⟶ Spec (A^Γ)` over `Spec K`.  Speiser descent
371	(`affineGaloisQuotientHomEquiv`), never Noether invariant finiteness. -/
372	theorem existsUnique_pullbackBaseChange_of_affine
373	    (t : Spec (CommRingCat.of B) ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of K))
374	    (ht : t = Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K B)))
375	    (h : pullback t (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K L)))
376	      ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of A))
377	    (hover : h ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap L A)) = pullback.snd _ _)
378	    (hequiv : (pullbackSemilinearGalAction K L t).IsEquivariant
379	      (specSemilinearGalAction K L A) h) :
380	    ∃! u : {u : Spec (CommRingCat.of B) ⟶
381	        Spec (CommRingCat.of (invariantsSubalgebra K L A)) //
382	      u ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K (invariantsSubalgebra K L A))) = t},
383	      pullbackBaseChange K L
384	          (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K (invariantsSubalgebra K L A))))
385	          t u.1 u.2
386	        ≫ (affineQuotientPullbackIso K L A).hom = h := by
387	  subst ht
388	  have hover' : ((pullbackSpecLIso K L B).inv ≫ h)
389	      ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap L A))
390	      = Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap L (L ⊗[K] B))) := by
391	    rw [Category.assoc, hover, pullbackSpecLIso_inv_snd]
392	  have hequiv' : ∀ γ : L ≃ₐ[K] L,
393	      (toSpecAut (L ≃ₐ[K] L) (L ⊗[K] B) γ).hom ≫ ((pullbackSpecLIso K L B).inv ≫ h)
394	        = ((pullbackSpecLIso K L B).inv ≫ h) ≫ (toSpecAut (L ≃ₐ[K] L) A γ).hom := by
395	    intro γ
396	    have h1 := hequiv γ
397	    rw [pullbackSemilinearGalAction_act_hom, specSemilinearGalAction_act] at h1
398	    rw [← Category.assoc, toSpecAut_hom_pullbackSpecLIso_inv, Category.assoc,
399	      Category.assoc, h1]
400	  set w := (affineGaloisQuotientHomEquiv K L A B).symm
401	      ⟨(pullbackSpecLIso K L B).inv ≫ h, hover', hequiv'⟩ with hwdef
402	  have hclause : pullbackBaseChange K L
403	      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K (invariantsSubalgebra K L A))))
404	      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K B))) w.1 w.2
405	      ≫ (affineQuotientPullbackIso K L A).hom = h := by
406	    rw [pullbackBaseChange_comp_affineQuotientPullbackIso_hom, hwdef,
407	      Equiv.apply_symm_apply]
408	    exact Iso.hom_inv_id_assoc _ _
409	  refine ⟨w, hclause, fun y hy => ?_⟩
410	  replace hy : pullbackBaseChange K L
411	      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K (invariantsSubalgebra K L A))))
412	      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K B))) y.1 y.2
413	      ≫ (affineQuotientPullbackIso K L A).hom = h := hy
414	  apply (affineGaloisQuotientHomEquiv K L A B).injective
415	  apply Subtype.ext
416	  rw [hwdef, Equiv.apply_symm_apply]
417	  change (affineGaloisQuotientHomEquiv K L A B y).1 = (pullbackSpecLIso K L B).inv ≫ h
418	  rw [pullbackBaseChange_comp_affineQuotientPullbackIso_hom] at hy
419	  rw [← hy, Iso.inv_hom_id_assoc]

421	/-! ## Globalized uniqueness -/
422	
423	/-- **Globalized uniqueness of the descended morphism**: for *any* scheme `T` over
424	`Spec K`, two morphisms `T ⟶ Spec (A^Γ)` over `Spec K` with the same base change
425	through the descent isomorphism are equal.  Restrict to an affine open cover and
426	apply the uniqueness clause of the affine `∃!`; morphisms of schemes are determined
427	by their restrictions to an open cover. -/
428	theorem affineQuotient_hom_unique {T : Scheme.{u}}
429	    {t : T ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)}
430	    {u₁ u₂ : T ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of (invariantsSubalgebra K L A))}
431	    (hu₁ : u₁ ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
432	      (algebraMap K (invariantsSubalgebra K L A))) = t)
433	    (hu₂ : u₂ ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
434	      (algebraMap K (invariantsSubalgebra K L A))) = t)
435	    (heq : pullbackBaseChange K L _ t u₁ hu₁ ≫ (affineQuotientPullbackIso K L A).hom
436	      = pullbackBaseChange K L _ t u₂ hu₂ ≫ (affineQuotientPullbackIso K L A).hom) :
437	    u₁ = u₂ := by
438	  apply T.affineOpenCover.openCover.hom_ext
439	  change ∀ i : T.affineOpenCover.I₀,
440	    T.affineOpenCover.f i ≫ u₁ = T.affineOpenCover.f i ≫ u₂
441	  intro i
442	  letI : Algebra K ↥(T.affineOpenCover.X i) :=
443	    ((Spec.preimage (T.affineOpenCover.f i ≫ t)).hom).toAlgebra
444	  have ht : T.affineOpenCover.f i ≫ t
445	      = Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K ↥(T.affineOpenCover.X i))) := by
446	    rw [RingHom.algebraMap_toAlgebra, CommRingCat.ofHom_hom, Spec.map_preimage]
447	  -- `@`-application: re-synthesis of `Algebra K ↥(𝒜.X i)` diverges (the instance
448	  -- search unfolds the affine-cover choice term), so pass the `letI` explicitly.
449	  have hEU := @existsUnique_pullbackBaseChange_of_affine K L _ _ _ A _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _
450	    ↥(T.affineOpenCover.X i) _ this
451	    (T.affineOpenCover.f i ≫ t) ht
452	    (pullbackBaseChange K L t (T.affineOpenCover.f i ≫ t) (T.affineOpenCover.f i) rfl
453	      ≫ pullbackBaseChange K L _ t u₁ hu₁ ≫ (affineQuotientPullbackIso K L A).hom)
454	    (by
455	      rw [Category.assoc, Category.assoc, affineQuotientPullbackIso_hom_specMap,
456	        pullbackBaseChange_snd]
457	      exact pullbackBaseChange_snd K L t _ (T.affineOpenCover.f i) rfl)
458	    (SemilinearGalAction.isEquivariant_pullbackBaseChange_comp t _
459	      (specSemilinearGalAction K L A)
460	      (SemilinearGalAction.isEquivariant_pullbackBaseChange_comp _ t
461	        (specSemilinearGalAction K L A)
462	        (isEquivariant_affineQuotientPullbackIso_hom K L A) u₁ hu₁)
463	      (T.affineOpenCover.f i) rfl)
464	  have h₁ : pullbackBaseChange K L
465	        (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K (invariantsSubalgebra K L A))))
466	        (T.affineOpenCover.f i ≫ t) (T.affineOpenCover.f i ≫ u₁)
467	        (by rw [Category.assoc, hu₁])
468	      ≫ (affineQuotientPullbackIso K L A).hom
469	      = pullbackBaseChange K L t (T.affineOpenCover.f i ≫ t) (T.affineOpenCover.f i) rfl
470	        ≫ pullbackBaseChange K L _ t u₁ hu₁ ≫ (affineQuotientPullbackIso K L A).hom := by
471	    rw [pullbackBaseChange_comp K L _ t _ u₁ hu₁ (T.affineOpenCover.f i) rfl,
472	      Category.assoc]
473	  have h₂ : pullbackBaseChange K L
474	        (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K (invariantsSubalgebra K L A))))
475	        (T.affineOpenCover.f i ≫ t) (T.affineOpenCover.f i ≫ u₂)
476	        (by rw [Category.assoc, hu₂])
477	      ≫ (affineQuotientPullbackIso K L A).hom
478	      = pullbackBaseChange K L t (T.affineOpenCover.f i ≫ t) (T.affineOpenCover.f i) rfl
479	        ≫ pullbackBaseChange K L _ t u₁ hu₁ ≫ (affineQuotientPullbackIso K L A).hom := by
480	    rw [pullbackBaseChange_comp K L _ t _ u₂ hu₂ (T.affineOpenCover.f i) rfl,
481	      Category.assoc, heq]
482	  exact congrArg Subtype.val
483	    (hEU.unique (y₁ := ⟨T.affineOpenCover.f i ≫ u₁, by rw [Category.assoc, hu₁]⟩)
484	      (y₂ := ⟨T.affineOpenCover.f i ≫ u₂, by rw [Category.assoc, hu₂]⟩) h₁ h₂)

486	/-! ## The fixed-isomorphism universal property and the main theorem -/
487	
488	/-- **The universal `T`-points property for the named affine quotient
489	isomorphism** `affineQuotientPullbackIso`.
490	
491	This is clause 3 of `isGaloisQuotient_spec`, exposed before it is packaged into
492	the proposition-valued `IsGaloisQuotient`.  Open restriction needs the equation
493	against this particular isomorphism: choosing an arbitrary existential witness
494	from the packaged predicate could twist the resulting quotient projection by an
495	automorphism. -/
496	theorem affineQuotient_existsUnique (T : Scheme.{u})
497	    (t : T ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of K))
498	    (h : pullback t (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K L))) ⟶
499	      Spec (CommRingCat.of A))
500	    (hover : h ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap L A)) =
501	      pullback.snd t (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K L))))
502	    (hequiv : (pullbackSemilinearGalAction K L t).IsEquivariant
503	      (specSemilinearGalAction K L A) h) :
504	    ∃! u : {u : T ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of (invariantsSubalgebra K L A)) //
505	        u ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
506	          (algebraMap K (invariantsSubalgebra K L A))) = t},
507	      pullbackBaseChange K L
508	          (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
509	            (algebraMap K (invariantsSubalgebra K L A)))) t u.1 u.2 ≫
510	        (affineQuotientPullbackIso K L A).hom = h := by
511	  -- local affine solutions on the pieces of an affine open cover
512	  have hloc : ∀ i : T.affineOpenCover.I₀,
513	      ∃ u : {u : Spec (T.affineOpenCover.X i) ⟶
514	          Spec (CommRingCat.of (invariantsSubalgebra K L A)) //
515	        u ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K (invariantsSubalgebra K L A)))
516	          = T.affineOpenCover.f i ≫ t},
517	        pullbackBaseChange K L
518	            (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K (invariantsSubalgebra K L A))))
519	            (T.affineOpenCover.f i ≫ t) u.1 u.2
520	          ≫ (affineQuotientPullbackIso K L A).hom
521	        = pullbackBaseChange K L t (T.affineOpenCover.f i ≫ t)
522	            (T.affineOpenCover.f i) rfl ≫ h := by
523	    intro i
524	    letI : Algebra K ↥(T.affineOpenCover.X i) :=
525	      ((Spec.preimage (T.affineOpenCover.f i ≫ t)).hom).toAlgebra
526	    have ht : T.affineOpenCover.f i ≫ t
527	        = Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K ↥(T.affineOpenCover.X i))) := by
528	      rw [RingHom.algebraMap_toAlgebra, CommRingCat.ofHom_hom, Spec.map_preimage]
529	    -- `@`-application: see `affineQuotient_hom_unique` (instance-diamond dodge)
530	    exact (@existsUnique_pullbackBaseChange_of_affine K L _ _ _ A _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _
531	      ↥(T.affineOpenCover.X i) _ this
532	      (T.affineOpenCover.f i ≫ t) ht
533	      (pullbackBaseChange K L t (T.affineOpenCover.f i ≫ t) (T.affineOpenCover.f i) rfl
534	        ≫ h)
535	      (by
536	        rw [Category.assoc, hover]
537	        exact pullbackBaseChange_snd K L t _ (T.affineOpenCover.f i) rfl)
538	      (SemilinearGalAction.isEquivariant_pullbackBaseChange_comp t _
539	        (specSemilinearGalAction K L A) hequiv (T.affineOpenCover.f i) rfl)).exists
540	  choose v hv using hloc
541	  -- the local solutions agree on overlaps, by the globalized uniqueness
542	  have hglue : ∀ i j : T.affineOpenCover.I₀,
543	      pullback.fst (T.affineOpenCover.f i) (T.affineOpenCover.f j) ≫ (v i).1
544	        = pullback.snd _ _ ≫ (v j).1 := by
545	    intro i j
546	    have hsnd : pullback.snd (T.affineOpenCover.f i) (T.affineOpenCover.f j)
547	          ≫ (T.affineOpenCover.f j ≫ t)
548	        = pullback.fst (T.affineOpenCover.f i) (T.affineOpenCover.f j)
549	            ≫ (T.affineOpenCover.f i ≫ t) := by
550	      rw [← Category.assoc, ← pullback.condition, Category.assoc]
551	    have hi : pullbackBaseChange K L
552	          (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K (invariantsSubalgebra K L A))))
553	          (pullback.fst (T.affineOpenCover.f i) (T.affineOpenCover.f j)
554	            ≫ (T.affineOpenCover.f i ≫ t))
555	          (pullback.fst _ _ ≫ (v i).1) (by rw [Category.assoc, (v i).2])
556	        ≫ (affineQuotientPullbackIso K L A).hom
557	        = pullbackBaseChange K L t _
558	            (pullback.fst _ _ ≫ T.affineOpenCover.f i) (Category.assoc _ _ _) ≫ h := by
559	      rw [pullbackBaseChange_comp_assoc K L _ (T.affineOpenCover.f i ≫ t) _ (v i).1
560	          (v i).2 (pullback.fst _ _) rfl,
561	        pullbackBaseChange_comp_assoc K L t (T.affineOpenCover.f i ≫ t) _
562	          (T.affineOpenCover.f i) rfl (pullback.fst _ _) rfl, hv i]
563	    have hj : pullbackBaseChange K L
564	          (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K (invariantsSubalgebra K L A))))
565	          (pullback.fst (T.affineOpenCover.f i) (T.affineOpenCover.f j)
566	            ≫ (T.affineOpenCover.f i ≫ t))
567	          (pullback.snd _ _ ≫ (v j).1) (by rw [Category.assoc, (v j).2]; exact hsnd)
568	        ≫ (affineQuotientPullbackIso K L A).hom
569	        = pullbackBaseChange K L t _
570	            (pullback.snd _ _ ≫ T.affineOpenCover.f j)
571	            (by rw [Category.assoc]; exact hsnd) ≫ h := by
572	      rw [pullbackBaseChange_comp_assoc K L _ (T.affineOpenCover.f j ≫ t) _ (v j).1
573	          (v j).2 (pullback.snd _ _) hsnd,
574	        pullbackBaseChange_comp_assoc K L t (T.affineOpenCover.f j ≫ t) _
575	          (T.affineOpenCover.f j) rfl (pullback.snd _ _) hsnd, hv j]
576	    have hcongr : pullbackBaseChange K L t
577	          (pullback.fst (T.affineOpenCover.f i) (T.affineOpenCover.f j)
578	            ≫ (T.affineOpenCover.f i ≫ t))
579	          (pullback.fst _ _ ≫ T.affineOpenCover.f i) (Category.assoc _ _ _)
580	        = pullbackBaseChange K L t _
581	            (pullback.snd _ _ ≫ T.affineOpenCover.f j)
582	            (by rw [Category.assoc]; exact hsnd) :=
583	      pullbackBaseChange_congr K L t _ pullback.condition _
584	    exact affineQuotient_hom_unique K L A (by rw [Category.assoc, (v i).2])
585	      (by rw [Category.assoc, (v j).2]; exact hsnd)
586	      (hi.trans (by rw [hcongr]; exact hj.symm))
587	  -- glue the local solutions
588	  set w : T ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of (invariantsSubalgebra K L A)) :=
589	    T.affineOpenCover.openCover.glueMorphisms (fun i => (v i).1) hglue with hw
590	  have hι : ∀ i, T.affineOpenCover.f i ≫ w = (v i).1 := fun i =>
591	    T.affineOpenCover.openCover.ι_glueMorphisms (fun i => (v i).1) hglue i
592	  have hwt : w ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
593	      (algebraMap K (invariantsSubalgebra K L A))) = t := by
594	    apply T.affineOpenCover.openCover.hom_ext
595	    change ∀ i : T.affineOpenCover.I₀,
596	      T.affineOpenCover.f i ≫ w ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
597	        (algebraMap K (invariantsSubalgebra K L A))) = T.affineOpenCover.f i ≫ t
598	    intro i
599	    rw [← Category.assoc, hι i, (v i).2]
600	  have hmain : pullbackBaseChange K L
601	      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K (invariantsSubalgebra K L A))))
602	      t w hwt ≫ (affineQuotientPullbackIso K L A).hom = h := by
603	    apply (Scheme.Pullback.openCoverOfLeft T.affineOpenCover.openCover t
604	      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K L)))).hom_ext
605	    change ∀ i : T.affineOpenCover.I₀,
606	      pullbackBaseChange K L t (T.affineOpenCover.f i ≫ t) (T.affineOpenCover.f i) rfl
607	        ≫ (pullbackBaseChange K L
608	            (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K (invariantsSubalgebra K L A))))
609	            t w hwt ≫ (affineQuotientPullbackIso K L A).hom)
610	      = pullbackBaseChange K L t (T.affineOpenCover.f i ≫ t)
611	          (T.affineOpenCover.f i) rfl ≫ h
612	    intro i
613	    rw [← Category.assoc,
614	      ← pullbackBaseChange_comp K L _ t (T.affineOpenCover.f i ≫ t) w hwt
615	        (T.affineOpenCover.f i) rfl,
616	      pullbackBaseChange_congr K L _ (T.affineOpenCover.f i ≫ t) (hι i) _, hv i]
617	  exact ⟨⟨w, hwt⟩, hmain, fun y hy => Subtype.ext
618	    (affineQuotient_hom_unique K L A y.2 hwt (hy.trans hmain.symm))⟩
619	
620	/-- **The affine finite Galois quotient theorem** (campaign `G2`, wave-2 milestone):
621	for the affine model `specSemilinearGalAction` of a semilinear `Gal(L/K)`-action on
622	`Spec A`, the canonical morphism `Spec (A^Γ) ⟶ Spec K` is a finite Galois quotient —
623	the full `IsGaloisQuotient` predicate: the `Γ`-equivariant base-change isomorphism
624	over `Spec L` (`affineQuotientPullbackIso`, Speiser descent) together with the
625	universal `T`-points property `Hom_K(T, Spec A^Γ) ≅ Hom_L(T_L, Spec A)^Γ` for
626	**all** schemes `T` (affine case via `affineGaloisQuotientHomEquiv`, globalized by
627	gluing along an affine open cover of `T`). -/
628	theorem isGaloisQuotient_spec :
629	    IsGaloisQuotient (specSemilinearGalAction K L A)
630	      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K (invariantsSubalgebra K L A)))) :=
631	  ⟨affineQuotientPullbackIso K L A, affineQuotientPullbackIso_hom_specMap K L A,
632	    isEquivariant_affineQuotientPullbackIso_hom K L A,
633	    affineQuotient_existsUnique K L A⟩
634	
635	end AffineGaloisQuotient
636	
637	end AlgebraicJacobian.GaloisDescent
